content:
黄仁勋经历了令人震惊的失宠——从地球上最富有的人之一、人工智能繁荣的主要推动者之一，到卷入两起婚外情丑闻，并在不到两周的时间里从英伟达辞职。虽然许多人都关注这位英伟达前首席执行官与爱丽丝·黄（Alice Huang）的关系，后者据称向中国情报部门传递信息，但《华尔街日报》深入挖掘了将她介绍给詹森的人——上海的明星基金经理康伟，他恰好也是黄女士的丈夫。有报道称，康伟在2010年代认识了黄仁勋，当时他的投资公司大量涉足中国游戏公司。目前尚不清楚这段介绍是否早于康与爱丽丝的关系和婚姻，但与黄女士关系密切的消息人士表示，她在 2020 年代就能够与詹森走近。据《华尔街日报》报道，尽管是情侣，但康似乎接受了爱丽丝与詹森的关系，与这对夫妇关系密切的人表示，康经常开玩笑说她是亿万富翁的私人助理。不过，康伟不仅仅是一名普通的企业高管。在2007年接手中海基金之前，他曾作为申银万国的策略师在金融界名声大噪。这使他成为当时中国最年轻的共同基金总裁之一，最终于2010年独自创业并创立了上海河西。
也正是在这个时候，黄乐（黄乐）进入金融行业，先是在香港汇丰银行的私人银行部门工作，后来转到中信证券，并担任副总裁职务。正是在中信工作期间，黄乐与康有交集。上海河西于2014年和2015年与该证券公司签署了协议，到2016年，公司登记记录显示黄女士已加入该投资公司。据《经济时报》报道，黄爱丽入驻上海河西后，她获得了该公司25%的股份，而这些股份全部来自于康。剩余股份由康伟（48.75%）和他的商业伙伴朱晓明（26.25%）共同持有，黄丽娟（Alice Huang）通过上海玉玺投资管理咨询有限公司持有25%的股权。与此同时，康伟也开始向他的商业伙伴和投资者介绍黄丽娟（Alice Huang）作为他的妻子。一年后，朱和康在河西基金的一项投资获得了一笔巨额意外之财，两人在如何分配利润的问题上发生了争执。尽管如此，该交易产生的巨额利润使上海河西以约5亿元人民币从中国企业集团世纪华通手中收购了视频游戏公司杭州盛丰。
交易两年后，即2019年，杭州盛丰的所有权转移给一家境外实体，该实体最终并入Osmanthus Vale Holdings——一家在英属维尔京群岛注册成立的控股公司，并将黄乐（Alice Huang的中文名字）列为其唯一所有者。随后，该公司成立不到两个月就被第七大道控股收购。虽然黄女士是这笔交易的签署人，但据信她充当了“白手套”的角色，即代表他人行事以隐瞒身份的人，但目前尚不清楚这是针对上海河西和康维还是其他第三方。关于Alice H的信息并不多

【原文 English Original】
Jensen Huang had a stunning fall from grace — from being one of the richest people on Earth and one of the primary drivers of the AI boom to being implicated in two extramarital affair scandals and resigning from Nvidia in under two weeks. While many are focused on the former Nvidia chief’s relationship with Alice Huang, who was allegedly passing on information to Chinese intelligence , the Wall Street Journal dug deeper into the person who introduced her to Jensen — Kang Wei, a star fund manager in Shanghai who also happened to be Ms. Huang’s husband. There have been reports that Kang Wei met Jensen Huang in the 2010s, when his investment firm was heavily involved in Chinese gaming companies. It’s not clear if this introduction predated Kang’s relationship and marriage to Alice, but sources close to Ms. Huang said that she was able to get close to Jensen by the 2020s. Despite being a couple, the WSJ reported that Kang seemingly accepted Alice’s relationship with Jensen, with people close to the couple saying that he would often joke that she was a personal assistant to the billionaire. Kang Wei is not just an average business executive, though. He made a name for himself in the finance world as a strategist for Shenyin Wanguo before taking over the Zhonghai Fund in 2007. This made him one of the youngest mutual fund chiefs in China at that time, before finally setting out on his own and founding Shanghai Hexi in 2010. It was also around this time that Alice Huang, whose Chinese name is Huang Le, entered the financial industry, first working at HSBC’s private banking arm in Hong Kong, before moving to CITIC Securities, where she attained a vice president position. It was during her time at CITIC that Alice crossed paths with Kang. Shanghai Hexi signed a deal with the securities firm in 2014 and 2015, and by 2016, corporate registry records show that Ms. Huang had joined the investment firm. The Economic Times reports Alice Huang’s move into Shanghai Hexi resulted in her getting a 25% stake in the company, all of which came from Kang. The remaining shares were shared between Kang Wei, with 48.75%, and his business partner, Zhu Xiaoming, with 26.25%, with Alice Huang’s 25% ownership stake being held through Shanghai Yuxi Investment Management Consulting Co., Ltd. Meanwhile, Kang also started introducing Alice Huang as his wife to his business associates and investors. One year later, Zhu and Kang had a falling out when one of their investments under a Hexi fund resulted in a major windfall, with the two partners disagreeing on how the profits were to be shared. Nevertheless, the massive profit generated by the deal allowed Shanghai Hexi to purchase Hangzhou Shengfeng, a video game company, for around 500 million yuan from Chinese conglomerate Century Huatong. Two years after the transaction, in 2019, Hangzhou Shengfeng’s ownership was transferred to an offshore entity, which was eventually consolidated under Osmanthus Vale Holdings — a holding company incorporated in the British Virgin Islands and listed Huang Le, Alice Huang’s Chinese name, as its sole owner. It was then purchased by 7Road Holdings less than two months after it was founded. While Ms. Huang was the signatory in this deal, it’s believed that she served as a “white glove,” a person who operates on behalf of another to conceal their identity — but it remains unclear if this was for Shanghai Hexi and Kang Wei or some other third party. There is not much information on Alice Huang’s activities between 2019 and 2021. However, Shanghai Hexi invested in Shanghai Longjing Information Technology, a data center-focused subsidiary of Century Huatong in 2020, where Ms. Huang served as a director between 2021 and 2022, according to a report by The Wire China . At about the same time, 7Road Holdings expanded into cloud computing, just before ChatGPT brought AI LLMs to the forefront. The U.S. government’s ban on the export of Nvidia chips to China put this investment in jeopardy, though, forcing it to spin off the business as 7Road International in Singapore. We don’t know when 7Road Holdings sold its Singapore subsidiary, but corporate records show that by the time the company was renamed Megaspeed in March 2023, it was already under the ownership of Huang Le Limited and led by Ms. Huang. It was sold again in November 2023 to Swiftdata, a company owned by Singaporean Tan Yong Pong. Axios said that she left the firm as a managing director soon after this acquisition, but sources said that she kept working with the company afterward, with Kang Wei helping her get it off the ground. In the same year, Shanghai Century Litong was founded to build AI data centers in Shanghai and Shenzhen, with Jiangsu Lettall Electronic Co., an electronic components manufacturer, holding a 90% stake, while the remaining 10% is owned by Century Longteng, as reported by BigGo Finance . It should be noted that Century Longteng was renamed from Shanghai Yuxi Investment Management, with the firm pivoting its business from finance to cloud computing, and that even though Alice Huang has already exited the company by this time, it’s under the control of Huang Yu, who some sources say is Ms. Huang’s sister. A year after these data center acquisitions, Alice Huang began to be spotted in public with the former Nvidia CEO. A LinkedIn post showed her having drinks with a leather-clad Jensen Huang alongside other tech executives from NetThunder and Gigabyte at a post-Computex 2024 event. She was once again seen having dinner with him in a Taipei restaurant as reporters tried to interview him while one kid demanded his attention off camera. But more than these public sightings, Alice herself boasted about her “closeness” to the then CEO. People close to her said that she regularly posted photos with Jensen on her WeChat account, and even shared others with potential customers to help establish her credibility. She even reportedly claimed that Mr. Huang would celebrate her birthdays with restaurant dinners and gifts, with one Nvidia China sales employee also saying that she was a familiar face at the company’s annual event for China partners. An investigation revealed that from 2023 to 2025, Megaspeed imported $4.6 billion worth of Nvidia AI chips, while another $2 billion was routed through Speedmatrix , Megaspeed’s subsidiary with offices in Johor, Malaysia. Shanghai Century Litong also reportedly bought AI GPUs from other sources, with estimates putting the total number of banned chips moved through Alice Huang’s assistance at around 240,000, putting the shipments’ worth at around $7.5 billion. But even as Ms. Huang was making her international moves, Kang Wei was facing trouble at home. Chinese regulators fined him 2.5 million yuan, or approximately $380,000, in 2025, for violating sections of China’s Securities Law. This also led to a warning letter against him, issued in August 2026 by the China Securities Regulatory Commission. Despite running into trouble with the authorities, this massive paper trail showed how Kang Wei actively made moves that put Alice Huang close to Jensen Huang. Some questions remain, though, about the U.S. intelligence community’s claims that she worked with the Ministry of State Security (MSS), China’s primary intelligence and counterintelligence agency. If it’s true that Alice Huang worked with the MSS and passed on information to the agency, did she specifically target Jensen Huang, or did the spy agency simply discover their indiscretion and use that to force her to cooperate? Was all this planned by the MSS, or were they just shrewd business moves that allowed Kang to make more money while going under the radar of regulators? These are questions that only Kang Wei and Alice Huang (or the Chinese spy agency) can answer. But no matter the case, the fact remains that China acquired advanced AI chips that were supposed to be out of its reach because of this couple’s connections.

禽流感爆发后香港暂停京都家禽进口中国劳工公告栏
星期六, 14 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻英文版
禽流感爆发后香港暂停京都家禽进口
H5禽流感爆发后，香港于11月13日暂停从日本京都府进口家禽和鸡蛋。该禁令在日本当局发出通知后立即生效。贸易数据显示，香港进口了约1,030吨冷冻家禽和近250家加工厂
香港食品安全当局已指示本地业界，自 11 月 13 日星期五起立即暂停从日本京都府进口禽肉及相关产品，包括禽蛋。预防性进口禁令是由日本农业当局发出正式通知，报告该县爆发高致病性H5禽流感而触发的，旨在保障全境公共卫生。
食物环境卫生署食物安全中心证实，该措施适用于所有源自京都府的禽肉及禽蛋货物。食品安全监管机构发言人解释说，在日本农林水产省就该地区发生的疾病发出警报后，立即实施了进口管制。
该发言人补充说，该中心已就疫情与日本当局建立了直接沟通，并将在兽医遏制措施的实施过程中保持密切联系。此外，当地官员将密切关注世界动物卫生组织与日本兽医机构发布的最新疫情动态和监测数据，并指出，如果流行病学情况需要，政府将采取进一步的监管应对措施。
政府统计处编制的贸易数据反映，本地对日本家禽供应的需求稳定，今年首九个月，香港从日本进口约1,030吨冷冻家禽肉和约2.4994亿个家禽蛋。
食品安全当局强调，边境管制站仍严格执行标准进口检验协议，以确保只有合规且无病的货物才能到达当地消费者，并建议家禽进口商和餐饮经营者在暂停期间密切监控采购来源。

Hong Kong halts Kyoto poultry imports after avian flu outbreak | China Labour Bulletin Board
Saturday, 14 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong halts Kyoto poultry imports after avian flu outbreak
Hong Kong suspended poultry and egg imports from Japan's Kyoto Prefecture on 13 November after an H5 avian influenza outbreak. The ban, effective immediately, follows a notification from Japanese authorities. Trade data show Hong Kong imported about 1,030 tonnes of frozen poultry and nearly 250 mill
Hong Kong food safety authorities have instructed the local trade to suspend the import of poultry meat and related products, including poultry eggs, from Kyoto Prefecture in Japan with immediate effect on Friday 13 November. The precautionary import ban was triggered by an official notification from Japanese agricultural authorities reporting an outbreak of highly pathogenic H5 avian influenza in the prefecture, aimed at safeguarding public health across the territory.
The Centre for Food Safety of the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department confirmed that the measure applies to all poultry meat and poultry egg consignments originating from Kyoto Prefecture. A spokesman for the food safety watchdog explained that import controls were enacted swiftly following an alert from the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries of Japan regarding the disease occurrence in the region.
The spokesman added that the centre had already established direct communication with Japanese authorities regarding the outbreak and would maintain close contact as veterinary containment measures proceed. In addition, local officials will monitor ongoing epidemic updates and surveillance data published by the World Organisation for Animal Health alongside Japanese veterinary agencies, noting that the government will implement further regulatory responses should the epidemiological situation warrant.
Trade figures compiled by the Census and Statistics Department reflect steady local demand for Japanese poultry supplies, with Hong Kong importing approximately 1,030 tonnes of frozen poultry meat and roughly 249.94 million poultry eggs from Japan during the first nine months of this year.
Food safety authorities stressed that standard import inspection protocols remain strictly enforced at border control points to ensure that only compliant and disease-free consignments reach local consumers, advising poultry importers and catering operators to monitor sourcing origins closely during the suspension.

content:
圖為2026年1月4日，婦女們推著嬰兒車走在北京的街道上。(Adek BERRY/AFP via Getty Images)
【大紀元2026年11月14日訊】（大紀元記者王蘭報導）一項最新研究發現，中國1990年代生育率大幅下降，與中共加強執行一胎化政策密切相關。其中，一項將地方官員升遷與計劃生育指標掛鉤的政策，導致了生育率的驟降。
據以科技及研究成果為主的英文新聞網站Phys.org11月13日報導，中國的「獨生子女政策」被普遍認為是近代史上最嚴苛的公共政策之一。然而，關於該政策在多大程度上促成了中國生育率的急劇下降，學術界長期以來一直存在爭論。
1979年至1980年「獨生子女政策」出台後，中國的生育率並未立即有顯著變化。直到10年後的1990年代，生育率才大幅下滑，降幅超過三分之一，從每名女性生育約2.5個孩子降至1.6個，低於維持人口世代更替所需的2.1個水平。
斯坦福大學發表在《自然》（Nature）期刊上的研究指出，「自1970年代以來，中國經歷了三次生育率大幅下降，但這些下降發生的時間點與『獨生子女政策』的推行時間並不完全吻合，這引出了一個重要問題：究竟是什麼導致了這些生育率的下降，尤其是20世紀90年代那次劇烈的下滑？」
研究發現，生育率驟降比計劃生育實施滯後，很大程度源自於中共地方政府官員在執行「獨生子女政策」時所面臨的更強激勵機制。
1991年5月，中共正式在全國範圍內推廣「計劃生育一票否決制」，該制度規定，如果地方官員未能完成計劃生育目標，其職業晉升將受到嚴格限制。這為地方官員執行「獨生子女政策」創造了強有力的個人誘因。
通過比較各省實施「一孩政策」的時間差異，研究人員發現，該政策是中國20世紀90年代生育率下降的主要原因之一，導致1990年代中國總和生育率下降幅度增加一倍，推動生育率跌破人口世代更替水平。
結果顯示，「一票否決制」實施後，宮內節育器（IUD）的使用量增加，尤其是地方官員推薦的避孕方式。
中共官方主管部門（如原國家計生委、衛計委）多次公開表示，自20世紀70年代全面推行計劃生育以來，至2000年代中期，政策累計使中國少生了4億多人。
儘管該政策在2016年放寬至每對夫婦生育兩個孩子，並在2021年放寬至三個孩子，但中國的總和生育率仍然是世界上最低的國家之一。
中國面臨迫在眉睫的人口危機，聯合國預測到2100年中國人口數量可能縮減到目前的一半。
中國1979年開始實施的獨生子女政策嚴重阻礙了經濟增長。
高盛（Goldman Sachs）的一項研究發現，中國人口從2022年開始減少。中共官方統計數據幾十年來一直在系統性地誇大中國的出生率和總人口數字，中國的總和生育率在1991年跌破2.1的世代更替水平後持續下降，並跌破1.0，目前估計每名婦女生育0.8個孩子。
據《金融時報》報導，中國的人口下降速度預計將遠超日本，這將嚴重損害中國的經濟前景。
兒童是家庭的「超級消費者」（super-consumers），帶動了家庭支出的很大一部分。中國少子化導致多個世代的兒童人口大幅減少，嚴重削弱了中國的內需消費。
中國的GDP為21.6兆美元，僅為美國經濟規模的三分之二。中國官方給出的人均GDP約為每年13,800美元，約為美國的15%，實際上可能更低。
以此標準衡量，土耳其、俄羅斯和哈薩克（Kazakhstan）都比中國富裕。

title: Launch Preview: Starship, Vulcan, and Electron launches scheduled for busy week
zh_title: 发射预览：Starship、Vulcan 和 Electron 计划在繁忙的一周发射
summary: 来自四个国家的七枚火箭将于本周发射。星际飞船将尝试其迄今为止最重要的任务，而猎鹰 9 号将为美国太空军发射一对机密有效载荷。联合发射联盟计划让 Vulcan 执行其返回飞行任务，而 Electron 则将完成第 100 次任务，具有里程碑意义。在国际上，中国和韩国将分别发射未知的有效载荷和演示任务。猎鹰 9 号 | USSF-627（“R-5”）本周首次发射将由猎鹰 9 号火箭提供机密有效载荷
content:
来自四个国家的七枚火箭将于本周发射。星际飞船将尝试其迄今为止最重要的任务，而猎鹰 9 号将为美国太空军发射一对机密有效载荷。联合发射联盟计划让 Vulcan 执行其返回飞行任务，而 Electron 则将完成第 100 次任务，具有里程碑意义。在国际上，中国和韩国将分别发射未知的有效载荷和演示任务。猎鹰 9 号 | USSF-627（“R-5”）本周首次发射将由猎鹰 9 号火箭为美国太空军 (USSF) 提供机密有效载荷。该任务被指定为 USSF-627，最初计划于 11 月 8 日星期日发射。猎鹰 9 号现定于太平洋标准时间 11 月 9 日星期一晚上 7:07（世界标准时间 10 月 10 日 03:07）从范登堡太空部队基地 (VSFB) 的 4 号东部太空发射综合体 (SLC-4E) 起飞，距太平洋标准时间晚上 11:03 (07:03) 的窗口期已过去四分钟。 UTC 时间 11 月 10 日）。由于有效载荷的机密性质，卫星的确切数量尚不清楚。一些指标表明，基于猎鹰 9 号第二级的降落区，星盾将进行发射。 Starshield是为美国政府打造的Starlink版本，其主要客户是USSF、国家侦察办公室和太空发展局。范登堡太空部队基地 4E 号航天发射场发射台上的猎鹰 9 号火箭。
（图片来源：SpaceX）Falcon 9 是一款两级、70 m 高、部分可重复使用的火箭，第一级使用九个 Merlin 1D 海平面发动机，第二级使用单个真空优化的 Merlin 1D。Falcon 9 的第一级降落在自主无人机船上或着陆点，其整流罩在飞行后回收并重复使用。两个阶段都使用液体煤油和液氧作为推进剂。助推器 B1103 将在其第七次飞行中支持这项任务。此前，该助推器已支持 NROL-179、第一批传输层 A 和 E 以及三个星链任务的发射。猎鹰 9 号将搭乘 SpaceX 的无人机“当然我仍然爱你”着陆。米尔 |演示飞行 11 月 10 日星期二，韩国计划发射韩国军方小型卫星运载火箭和平号的第二次飞行。继 2023 年 12 月进行了不包括第二级的试飞之后，此次发射将是全尺寸火箭的首次轨道飞行。启动窗口于 05:00 UTC 开始，并延长至 09:00 UTC。和平号是一款四级固体燃料运载火箭，第四级采用液体燃料，可实现精确入轨。 2023 年 12 月飞行的版本能够运载 700 公斤至近地轨道，该版本疑似能够运载 1,000 公斤左右。长征2D |有效载荷未知 11 月 11 日星期三，长征 2D (CZ-2D) 火箭计划从酒泉卫星发射中心发射升空。
目前，发射计划于 11:40 UTC 进行，距离 11:32 UTC 开启并持续到 12:05 UTC 的窗口还有 8 分钟的时间。CZ-2D 将向轨道发射未知有效载荷。 CZ-2D 是一款两级、41 米高的运载火箭，能够向近地轨道 (LEO) 发射 3,500 公斤的重量。 CZ-2D的第一级和第二级均由四氧化二氮和不对称二甲肼提供动力，这两种推进剂都是自燃推进剂。周三的发射将是长征二号丁的第 107 次发射，也是 2026 年的第六次发射。快舟 11 |有效载荷未知本周第二个也是最后一个预定的中国任务

【原文 English Original】
Seven rockets from four countries are set to launch this week. Starship is set to attempt its most consequential mission yet, while Falcon 9 is set to launch a pair of classified payloads for the United States Space Force. The United Launch Alliance is scheduled to fly Vulcan on its return-to-flight mission, and Electron is set to reach a milestone 100th mission. Internationally, China and South Korea are set to launch an unknown payload and a demonstration mission, respectively. Falcon 9 | USSF-627 (“R-5”) The first launch of the week will feature Falcon 9 delivering a classified payload for the United States Space Force (USSF). The mission, designated USSF-627, was initially scheduled to launch on Sunday, Nov. 8. Falcon 9 is now set to take off from Space Launch Complex 4 East (SLC-4E) at Vandenberg Space Force Base (VSFB) on Monday, Nov. 9, at 7:07 PM PST (03:07 UTC on Nov. 10), four minutes into a window that extends until 11:03 PM PST (07:03 UTC on Nov. 10). Due to the classified nature of the payload, the exact quantity of satellites is unknown. Some indicators suggest a Starshield launch, based on drop zones for Falcon 9’s second stage. Starshield is a version of Starlink built for the United States government, with its primary customers being the USSF, National Reconnaissance Office, and the Space Development Agency. A Falcon 9 on the launch pad at Space Launch Complex-4E on Vandenberg Space Force Base. (Credit: SpaceX) Falcon 9 is a two-stage, 70 m-tall, partially reusable rocket that uses nine Merlin 1D sea-level engines on its first stage and a single vacuum-optimized Merlin 1D on its second stage. Falcon 9’s first stage lands either aboard an autonomous droneship or at a landing site, with its fairings being recovered and reused after flight. Both stages utilize liquid kerosene and liquid oxygen as propellants. Booster B1103 will be supporting this mission on its seventh flight. Previously, this booster has supported the launches of NROL-179, Tranche 1 Transport Layers A and E, and three Starlink missions. Falcon 9 will land downrange aboard SpaceX’s droneship Of Course I Still Love You . Mir | Demo Flight On Tuesday, Nov. 10, South Korea is set to launch the second flight of Mir, the South Korean military’s small satellite launch vehicle. This launch is set to be the first orbital flight of the full-scale rocket, following a test flight in December 2023 that did not include the second stage. The launch window opens at 05:00 UTC and extends until 09:00 UTC. Mir is a four-stage, solid-fuel launch vehicle with a liquid-fueled fourth stage for precise orbital insertion. The version that flew in December 2023 was capable of 700 kg to LEO, with this version suspected to be capable of around 1,000 kg. Chang Zheng 2D | Unknown Payload On Wednesday, Nov. 11, a Chang Zheng 2D (CZ-2D) rocket is scheduled to launch out of the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center. The launch is currently scheduled for 11:40 UTC, eight minutes into a window that opens at 11:32 UTC and extends until 12:05 UTC. CZ-2D will deliver an unknown payload into orbit. CZ-2D is a two-stage, 41 m-tall launch vehicle capable of delivering 3,500 kg to low-Earth orbit (LEO). CZ-2D’s first and second stages are both powered by dinitrogen tetroxide and unsymmetrical dimethyl hydrazine, both hypergolic propellants. Wednesday’s launch will be the 107th overall for CZ-2D, and sixth in 2026. Kuaizhou 11 | Unknown Payload The second and final scheduled Chinese mission of the week will see a Kuaizhou 11 rocket launch on Thursday, Nov. 12. Liftoff is set for 19:50 UTC from Site 95A at the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center, during a 45-minute launch window. Kuaizhou 11 is a four-stage Chinese rocket manufactured by the China Aerospace Science and Industry Corporation. Standing 25.3 m tall, the rocket can loft 1,500 kg to LEO with a liftoff thrust of 1,250 kN. This mission will be the eighth overall Kuaizhou 11 mission and the fourth of 2026. Vulcan VC6L | Amazon Leo (LV-01) United Launch Alliance’s (ULA) Vulcan rocket is set to launch on Friday, Nov. 13, from Space Launch Complex 41 (SLC-41) at Cape Canaveral Space Force Station. The 30-minute launch window opens at 12:54 PM EST (17:54 UTC). This will be the first flight of Vulcan in over nine months, following the ejection of one of Vulcan’s GEM-63XL solid rocket boosters at T+69 seconds on the USSF-87 mission. Flying aboard Vulcan will be a stack of 40 Amazon Leo satellites for Amazon’s Leo satellite internet constellation, a rival to SpaceX’s Starlink. A ULA Vulcan (USSF-87) sits next to a SpaceX Crew Dragon (Crew-12). (Credit: Tyler Gray for NSF) Vulcan is a two-stage launch vehicle with a range of launch configurations. Vulcan’s first stage is powered by two BE-4 engines built by Blue Origin, running on liquid methane and liquid oxygen propellants. Its second stage, Centaur V, is powered by twin RL10C engines running on liquid hydrogen and liquid oxygen. Centaur V can be configured as Centaur LEO, High Energy, or Endurance. Vulcan can also be configured with solid rocket boosters to augment liftoff thrust, with options ranging from zero to two, four, or six boosters. The payload is encapsulated by either a short (15.5 m) or a long (21.3 m) fairing. Vulcan will debut the Vulcan VC6L variant, designated by six solid boosters and the long fairing option. Vulcan will debut the LEO-optimized Centaur V, which is 1.94 m smaller than the existing Centaur V High Energy, which has flown on all previous Vulcan launches. Additionally, this flight is a certification flight of this Vulcan configuration for the United States Space Force. Amazon Leo (LV-01) will be the first of 38 scheduled for Vulcan and the fifth overall mission for Vulcan. Starship | Flight 15 / Starlink Group 31-2 Pending regulatory approval, Starship is set to fly its next, and most significant, mission no earlier than Friday, Nov. 13, at 4:45 PM CST (22:45 UTC). The launch window extends until 6:00 PM CST (00:00 UTC on Nov. 14). Flight 15 will feature two notable events: the first booster-catch attempt since Flight 8, following stage separation, and the first attempt to catch the ship, roughly 22 hours after liftoff. Starship is a two-stage, super-heavy-lift launch vehicle capable of lofting an estimated 100 tonnes. The first stage, named Super Heavy, features 33 Raptor 3 engines, running off of liquid methane and liquid oxygen propellants. The second stage, named Starship, features six Raptor 3 engines, three sea-level and three vacuum-optimized, also running off of liquid methane and liquid oxygen. Flying on Flight 15 will be Ship 42 and Booster 22, both on their first flights. Flight 15 is expected to deliver 26 Starlink v3 satellites to LEO. Like Flight 14, three of these satellites will feature imaging capabilities for imaging the heat shield of Starship in orbit. Flight 15 will be the 15th full-stack launch of Starship and the fourth for the system’s V3 configuration. Falcon 9 | USSF-317 (“R-6”) Falcon 9 is set to fly again on Friday, Nov. 13, from VSFB with another USSF mission. The designation for this flight is USSF-317. The launch window opens at 8:09 PM PST (04:09 UTC on Nov. 14), and lasts for four hours. This mission will fly another unknown quantity of presumed Starshield satellites to LEO. Booster B1100 will support this mission, marking its 11th flight. This booster has previously supported NROL-105, USSF-385, and eight Starlink missions. B1100 will land downrange aboard SpaceX’s droneship Of Course I Still Love You . Electron during its 95th launch “Happily Ever Faster.” Credit: Rocket Lab) Electron | The Mountain God Rises The last scheduled launch of the week will see Rocket Lab’s Electron launch from the Mahia Peninsula in New Zealand on Saturday, Nov. 14, at 05:30 UTC. This flight of Electron, named “The Mountain God Rises,” will deliver another iQPS satellite into LEO for iQPS’s synthetic aperture radar constellation (SAR). SAR is used to image the surface of the Earth and can penetrate through cloud layers. Electron is a two-stage small-lift vehicle capable of delivering up to 300 kg to LEO and 200 kg to Sun-synchronous orbit. The vehicle is fueled by liquid kerosene and liquid oxygen, which powers nine Rutherford engines on the first stage and a single vacuum-optimized Rutherford on the second stage. This mission will serve as Electron’s 100th overall mission — a notable milestone for the small rocket that first flew in 2017. In addition, this mission will serve as the 269th orbital launch attempt worldwide in 2026. ( Lead Image: Falcon 9 launches from Florida. Credit: Julia Bergeron for NSF) The post Launch Preview: Starship, Vulcan, and Electron launches scheduled for busy week appeared first on NASASpaceFlight.com .

title: Hong Kong culture chief attends BIGBANG concert, hails Kai Tak atmosphere

summary: 香港文化行政长官出席BIGBANG演唱会盛赞启德气氛 |中国劳工布告栏 星期六, 14 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工英文新闻 香港文化行政长官出席 BIGBANG 演唱会，赞扬启德气氛 文化体育及旅游局局长罗姗娜出席韩国流行乐团 BIGBANG 在启德体育公园举行的开幕演唱会。罗表示现场气氛热烈，并指出该乐队以前从未在同一城市举办过四场音乐会。她还接待了海外合作伙伴，他们对场地表示赞赏。文化体育及旅游局局长罗珊娜
content:
香港文化行政长官出席BIGBANG演唱会盛赞启德气氛 |中国劳工公告栏
星期六, 14 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻英文版
香港文化特长出席BIGBANG演唱会盛赞启德气氛
文化体育及旅游局局长罗淑英出席韩国流行乐团BIGBANG于启德体育公园举行的开幕演唱会。罗表示现场气氛热烈，并指出该乐队以前从未在同一城市举办过四场音乐会。她还接待了海外合作伙伴，他们对场地表示赞赏。
文化体育及旅游局局长罗姗娜周五晚上出席启德体育公园四场BIGBANG演唱会的第一场，并在社交媒体上发布照片，形容现场气氛激动人心。
罗写道，BIGBANG告诉她，他们以前从未在同一城市举办过四场演唱会，并补充说这次香港创下了新纪录。她说她不是 VIP（该团体的官方粉丝名称），但仍然很高兴能来到那里。
罗女士还透露，她曾接待过来自海外的高级合伙人，他们对场地的设施和氛围赞不绝口。 “这种积极的口碑是我们前进的动力，”她说。
BIGBANG 在新开幕的启德体育公园举行的为期四晚的演唱会是该场地首批大型国际演出之一，预计将提升香港作为区域娱乐中心的地位。
文化部长的出席突显了政府为推动大型文化和体育赛事而做出的努力，这符合其吸引国际游客和刺激当地经济的战略。

Hong Kong culture chief attends BIGBANG concert, hails Kai Tak atmosphere | China Labour Bulletin Board
Saturday, 14 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong culture chief attends BIGBANG concert, hails Kai Tak atmosphere
Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law attended K-pop group BIGBANG's opening concert at Kai Tak Sports Park. Law said the atmosphere was electric and noted the group had never held four concerts in the same city before. She also hosted overseas partners who praised the venue.
Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law attended the first of four BIGBANG concerts at Kai Tak Sports Park on Friday evening, posting photos on social media to describe the atmosphere as electric.
Law wrote that BIGBANG had told her they had never held four concerts in the same city before, adding that Hong Kong had set a new record this time. She said she was not a VIP — the group's official fandom name — but was still very excited to be there.
Law also revealed she had hosted senior partners from overseas who were full of praise for the venue's facilities and the atmosphere. 'This kind of positive word of mouth is the energy that keeps us going,' she said.
BIGBANG's four-night concert run at the newly opened Kai Tak Sports Park is one of the first major international performances at the venue, which is expected to boost Hong Kong's status as a regional entertainment hub.
The appearance by the culture minister underscores the government's efforts to promote large-scale cultural and sporting events, in line with its strategy to attract international visitors and stimulate the local economy.

李克强会见白东潭时，中国和泰国承诺建立更紧密的贸易和安全关系中国劳工公告栏
星期六, 14 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻英文版
李克强会见白东丹时，中国和泰国承诺加强贸易和安全关系
中国国务院总理李强和泰国总理白东赞同意加快新五年经济规划谈判，加强新能源、半导体等领域合作，加强打击跨境犯罪执法。
2026 年 11 月 13 日 22:57 香港时间 · 更新于 11 月 14 日 04:24 · 阅读时间 1 分钟
中国国务院总理李强周五在曼谷会见泰国总理白东丹，这是他对泰国进行正式访问的一部分，双方承诺深化贸易、投资和安全领域的双边关系。
李克强表示，中方愿同泰方高质量推进“一带一路”合作，实施中泰铁路等重大项目，加紧磋商新的五年经贸合作规划。据中国官方媒体报道，他强调了新能源、半导体和人工智能等潜在合作领域的互利共赢。
李克强还表示，中方愿进口更多泰国优质产品，鼓励中国企业赴泰投资。他呼吁泰国为中国企业提供公平、稳定、可预期的营商环境。在安全方面，李克强表示，双方要加强交流，加大打击非法活动的力度。当前国际形势不稳定不确定因素较多，中方愿同泰方密切配合，为世界和平与发展作出贡献。
培东赞表示，泰方愿同中方加强高层交往，扩大双边贸易，深化互利合作。她重申泰国致力于为中国投资者维持良好的营商环境，加强执法和安全合作，包括打击网络赌博和电信诈骗。她还承诺确保中国游客的安全。
会谈后，两国领导人共同见证了多项合作文件的签署。

China, Thailand pledge closer trade, security ties as Li meets Paetongtarn
Chinese Premier Li Qiang and Thai Prime Minister Paetongtarn Shinawatra agreed to accelerate talks on a new five-year economic plan, boost cooperation in sectors such as new energy and semiconductors, and strengthen law enforcement against cross-border crimes.
13 Nov 2026 at 22:57 HKT · updated 14 Nov, 04:24 · 1 min read
Chinese Premier Li Qiang met Thai Prime Minister Paetongtarn Shinawatra in Bangkok on Friday as part of his official visit to Thailand, where both sides pledged to deepen bilateral ties across trade, investment and security.
Li said China is willing to work with Thailand to advance high-quality Belt and Road cooperation, implement major projects such as the China-Thailand railway, and step up consultations on a new five-year economic and trade cooperation plan. He highlighted potential collaboration in new energy, semiconductors and artificial intelligence as areas for mutual benefit, according to Chinese state media.
Li also expressed China's readiness to import more high-quality products from Thailand and encouraged Chinese companies to invest in the country. He called on Thailand to provide a fair, stable and predictable business environment for Chinese firms. On security, Li said both sides should strengthen exchanges and intensify efforts to combat illegal activities. Noting ongoing instability and uncertainty in the global situation, he said China is willing to closely coordinate with Thailand to contribute to global peace and development.
Paetongtarn said Thailand is willing to strengthen high-level exchanges with China, expand bilateral trade and deepen mutually beneficial cooperation. She affirmed Thailand's commitment to maintaining a good business environment for Chinese investors and enhancing law enforcement and security cooperation, including cracking down on online gambling and telecom fraud. She also pledged to ensure the safety of Chinese tourists.
Following the talks, the two leaders witnessed the signing of several cooperation documents.
