Would Jensen Huang’s fall dent China’s AI ambitions? | The Straits Times
Would Jensen Huang’s fall dent China’s AI ambitions?
Sign up now: Get insights on Asia's fast-moving developments
Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, seen here addressing media in Beijing in May, is being investigated for being the target of a foreign intelligence operation.
Published Nov 13, 2026, 10:05 PM
Updated Nov 13, 2026, 10:05 PM
Jensen Huang’s resignation at Nvidia has raised fears that the US may tighten chip controls, threatening China’s access to advanced AI computing.
China called the spy claims “purely unsubstantiated” and said the US is using them as a pretext for “technology blockades” against China.
Analysts said pressure on Chinese AI firms may grow in the short term, but the shock could also speed up domestic chip development.
BEIJING – The abrupt resignation of Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang has raised fresh questions about China’s access to advanced American artificial intelligence chips, with Beijing accusing Washington of using espionage allegations to justify tighter technology restrictions even as Chinese analysts play down the potential fallout.
Huang, who personally lobbied US President Donald Trump to ease restrictions on chip sales to China, was among the most vocal advocates for keeping American technology flowing to the world’s second-largest economy.
His departure now threatens to weaken that voice in Washington at a time when US lawmakers are pressing for stricter controls on China’s access to advanced computing power, potentially adding urgency to Beijing’s push for semiconductor self-sufficiency.
Chinese analysts said the consequences could cut both ways – further restrictions may constrain Chinese AI developers in the short term, while strengthening the push for domestic alternatives and creating opportunities for Chinese chipmakers such as Huawei.
Huang’s Nov 12 resignation followed revelations of extramarital affairs, including one involving a Chinese woman alleged by US officials to have links to Chinese intelligence. It marked the end of his 33-year tenure during which he built Nvidia into the world’s leading supplier of the chips that power AI.
He had long argued that excluding China from American chip technology would be counterproductive and would deprive US companies of revenue while encouraging Chinese competitors to develop their own alternatives.
Since news of Huang’s involvement with an alleged Chinese spy broke, China’s Foreign Ministry has repeatedly rejected the espionage allegations, calling them “purely unsubstantiated” and “smears” against China. US officials have not provided evidence for their claims.
At a regular press briefing on Nov 12, Chinese Foreign Ministry spokeswoman Mao Ning said the US “should stop fabricating the Chinese spy narratives as a pretext for imposing technology blockades,” adding that China’s technological progress is driven by independent innovation and open cooperation.
Chinese state media Global Times also criticised what it described as growing political interference in American technology companies, arguing that Huang’s departure reflected the increasing use of national security concerns to constrain commercial decisions involving China.
Wu Xinbo, director of Fudan University’s Centre for American Studies, played down the potential impact on China’s AI ambitions, saying that China was already committed to developing its own semiconductor capabilities, regardless of whether Washington relaxed or tightened its restrictions.
He pointed to competing views within China over whether to continue purchasing American chips, which still offered performance advantages, or concentrate on developing domestic alternatives.
“If the US tightens its restrictions on chip export controls, which seems likely, it would strengthen the latter camp and benefit Chinese chipmakers,” said Wu, who advises China’s Foreign Ministry.
“The message sent is that the US cannot be relied upon, it can tighten restrictions at any time so we still have to depend on ourselves.”
More fundamentally, Wu said that China and the US were increasingly competing on different fronts. The US is more focused on producing the most advanced AI models, chips and computing capabilities, while Beijing places greater emphasis on commercialising AI and integrating it into manufacturing, healthcare and everyday life.
Zhu Feng, dean of the School of International Studies at Nanjing University, told ST that greater determination to develop domestic alternatives would not immediately close the technological gap.
No impact on chip supply, partnerships amid resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang: Singtel
Why is Nvidia king of the AI chip hill and how soon can rivals catch up?
While tighter restrictions could accelerate investment in domestic alternatives, they would not immediately eliminate China’s dependence on foreign chips, he said. This is because China would not be able to match the capabilities of leading companies such as Nvidia, Taiwan’s TSMC and South Korea’s SK Hynix in the short term, he added.
“Pressure on China will certainly increase in the short term, but in the medium to long term, much depends on whether China can keep its composure and achieve further technological breakthroughs of its own,” he said.
Since 2022, the US government has barred Nvidia from selling its most advanced chips to China. However, in 2025, Trump allowed Nvidia to sell H20 chips to China on a case-by-case basis, and later extended it to Nvidia’s H200 chips.
On Nov 13, shares of Chinese tech companies such as Alibaba, Tencent and Z.ai took a hit as Nvidia’s leadership crisis raised fears that Washington could further tighten restrictions on China’s access to advanced AI computing.
Although Washington restricts direct exports of Nvidia’s top AI chips to China, Chinese companies are still able to rent such advanced computing power from overseas data centres.
In a commentary published on Nov 13 after Huang’s resignation, Global Times warned that other technology executives could face similar scrutiny if their business interests conflicted with Washington’s political agenda.
It also argued that Huang’s Chinese heritage and his calls for continued chip exports had made him particularly vulnerable to political suspicion.

Nanjing University’s Zhu warned that the allegations could fuel a new wave of anti-Chinese sentiment in American political and business circles.
He said the controversy could accelerate efforts by some in Washington to sever technological ties with China, extending beyond chip export controls to broader restrictions on cooperation at a time when advances in AI require both competition and dialogue.
“Whether this will lead to a new Cold War in the field of AI remains to be seen,” he said.

流亡柬埔寨政客以镇压为由谴责法语国家峰会海峡时报
流亡柬埔寨政客谴责法语国家峰会，称镇压
立即注册：深入了解亚洲的快速发展
发表于 2026 年 11 月 13 日，晚上 08:04
更新于 2026 年 11 月 13 日 08:04 PM
曼谷，11月13日 - 流亡的柬埔寨反对派人士桑兰西谴责包括法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙在内的领导人本周末在金边举行的聚会是“骗局”，称这个东南亚国家的政治迫害和有组织犯罪使其成为不合适的场所。
国家元首和高级部长正在柬埔寨首都举行法语国家国际组织（OIF）峰会。该组织促进法语国家之间的合作，并将和平、民主和人权列为其核心原则。
“我认为峰会将在错误的时间、错误的地点举行，”兰西周五在巴黎通过电话告诉路透社。他逃离柬埔寨后过着自我流放的生活，在柬埔寨他被缺席定罪多项罪行，他的政党也被取缔。
“柬埔寨在民主、法治、人权、司法独立方面处于非常困难的境地……这完全违背了法语国家应代表的价值观，”他说。 “我认为这是一场骗局。这是一次奇怪的峰会。”
柬埔寨新闻部长内斯·菲克特拉 (Neth Pheaktra) 表示，政府“没有时间争论”，专注于使这次会议取得成功。
周一，联合国驻柬埔寨人权特使汤姆·安德鲁斯敦促政府在峰会前释放 100 多名因“行使基本自由”而被拘留的人，其中包括环保活动人士。他表示，这样做将尊重 OIF 的价值观。
由 26 个柬埔寨组织组成的联盟本周向加拿大和法国驻金边大使馆提交了一份联合请愿书，理由是“民主倒退、侵犯人权和对公民社会的攻击”。它呼吁参加峰会的国家抗议“迅速恶化的局势”。
爱丽舍宫的一名官员告诉路透社，法国在峰会上“要传达信息”，人权和法治问题正在“各个层面”得到解决。
这位官员表示：“空席政策并不是推动这些问题取得进展的最佳方式。”
强人洪森统治柬埔寨近四十年，直到 2023 年将权力移交给他的儿子洪马内。他保留了相当大的影响力，包括作为执政的柬埔寨人民党的领导人。
人权组织表示，政治镇压仍在继续，政府压制异见人士、独立媒体和民间社会。
柬埔寨也已成为价值数十亿美元的网络欺诈行业的中心，犯罪集团（主要是华人）建立了庞大的诈骗场所，由被贩运的工人组成，被迫诈骗世界各地的人们。政府去年发起了打击行动，但批评人士表示，它未能针对与该行业相关的有权势精英。
另一位流亡柬埔寨政治家穆索楚亚表示：“当犯罪网络逍遥法外、公民的民主权利被剥夺时，法语国家就无法可信地促进共同繁荣。”路透社

Exiled Cambodian politician denounces Francophonie summit, citing repression
Sign up now: Get insights on Asia's fast-moving developments
Published Nov 13, 2026, 08:04 PM
Updated Nov 13, 2026, 08:04 PM
BANGKOK, Nov 13 - Exiled Cambodian opposition figure Sam Rainsy denounced a gathering of leaders, including French President Emmanuel Macron, in Phnom Penh this weekend as a "sham", saying political persecution and organised crime in the Southeast Asian nation made it an inappropriate venue.
Heads of state and senior ministers are meeting in the Cambodian capital for a summit of the International Organisation of La Francophonie (OIF). The organisation promotes cooperation between French-speaking nations and lists peace, democracy and human rights among its core tenets.
"I think the summit is going to take place at the wrong place at the wrong time," Rainsy told Reuters on Friday by phone from Paris. He lives in self-exile after fleeing Cambodia, where he has been convicted of multiple offences in absentia and his political party has been banned.
"Cambodia is in a very difficult situation in terms of democracy, the rule of law, human rights, independence of the judiciary...which is totally contrary to the values that the Francophonie is supposed to represent," he said. "I think it is a sham. It is a strange summit."
Neth Pheaktra, Cambodia's minister of information, said the government had "no time for polemics" and was focused on making the gathering a success.
On Monday, Tom Andrews, the United Nations' human rights envoy to Cambodia, urged the government to release more than 100 people detained for "exercising their fundamental freedoms", including environmental activists, before the summit. He said doing so would honor the OIF's values.
A coalition of 26 Cambodian organisations this week handed the Canadian and French embassies in Phnom Penh a joint petition citing "democratic backsliding, human rights violations, and attacks on civil society". It called on states attending the summit to protest the "rapidly deteriorating situation".
An Elysee official told Reuters that France had "messages to convey" at the summit and that human rights and rule of law were being addressed "at all levels".
"The policy of the empty chair is not the best way to move these issues forward," the official said.
Strongman Hun Sen governed Cambodia for nearly four decades until 2023, when he handed power to his son, Hun Manet. He retains considerable influence, including as head of the ruling Cambodian People's Party.
Rights groups say political repression has continued, with the government stifling dissent, independent media and civil society.
Cambodia has also become an epicenter of the multibillion-dollar cyberfraud industry, as criminal syndicates, mostly of Chinese origin, have built sprawling scam compounds staffed by trafficked workers forced to defraud people worldwide. The government launched a crackdown last year, but critics say it has failed to target powerful elites linked to the industry.
“The Francophonie cannot credibly promote shared prosperity while criminal networks operate with impunity and citizens are denied their democratic rights,” said Mu Sochua, another exiled Cambodian politician. REUTERS

summary: 据报道，两间天主教堂因计划为大埔火灾遇难者举行一周年纪念弥撒而受到警方询问。大埔圣母无玷圣心堂。照片：Dennis Lo，来自 Google 地图。前电台主持人兼当地教区居民安东尼·姚 (Antony Yiu) 表示，大埔圣母无玷圣心堂于周日宣布举行特别仪式，哀悼去年 11 月致命火灾中丧生的 168 人，随后两次受到警方询问。此后，教会以纪念“过去去世的兄弟姐妹”的一般仪式取代了周年纪念弥撒。
content:
据报道，两间天主教堂因计划为大埔火灾遇难者举行一周年纪念弥撒而受到警方询问。大埔圣母无玷圣心堂。照片：Dennis Lo，来自 Google 地图。前电台主持人兼当地教区居民安东尼·姚 (Antony Yiu) 表示，大埔圣母无玷圣心堂于周日宣布举行特别仪式，哀悼去年 11 月致命火灾中丧生的 168 人，随后两次受到警方询问。据周二的脸书帖子称，该教堂已将周年纪念弥撒改为为“过去一年中去世的兄弟姐妹”举行的一般仪式。 “作为一名常去教堂的人，我尊重教会的决定。但我想问：警察现在有权力决定信徒为谁祈祷吗？”姚写道。在该帖子已被删除的社交媒体帖子的截图中，该教会写道：“大埔宏福苑火灾即将一周年，悲伤依然挥之不去。” 2026 年 4 月 20 日，远处看到的宏福苑。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 “十一月是天主教会的纪念月，我们祈祷死者永远安息……我们祈求上帝的怜悯、同情和祝福。”据当地媒体援引教堂信徒的消息称，根据法律，湾仔的一座教堂——迦密山圣母教堂也计划举行纪念弥撒，纪念致命火灾一周年。不过，教会并没有公开弥撒。
在周二的商业广播节目中，卡梅尔山圣母教区牧师托马斯·劳神父表示，十一月是天主教团体的纪念月，教堂每年都会举办这样的纪念活动。罗托马斯 (Thomas Law)，湾仔迦密山圣母堂堂区神父。照片：托马斯·劳，来自 Facebook。当被问及弥撒是否会向大埔火灾的受害者祈祷时，罗说，任何愿意为他们祈祷的人都可以这样做，并且“不需要添加或减少”。他表示警方尚未联系他。但广播节目播出数小时后，记者从劳处获悉，三名警察对他进行了盘问，询问弥撒的细节以及有多少人会参加。劳说，警方没有威胁他，他们只是担心和“好奇”。警方在回应《香港自由报》时表示，警方在处理活动时会“根据实际情况依法行事，并在必要时与组织者保持沟通”。保安局局长邓克里斯上周在电视节目中表示，他理解受害者家属希望纪念这一周年的愿望。他表示，只要他们遵守法律，当局“肯定会提供协助”。当被问及警方是否收到追悼会申请时，唐仅表示警方会考虑场地安全和家属意愿等因素。

【原文 English Original】
Two Catholic churches have reportedly been questioned by police over plans to hold a one-year anniversary memorial mass for victims of the Tai Po fire. Immaculate Heart of Mary Church in Tai Po. Photo: Dennis Lo, via Google Maps. Immaculate Heart of Mary Church in Tai Po was questioned by police twice after announcing a special service this Sunday to mourn the 168 people killed in the fatal blaze last November, former radio host and local parishioner Antony Yiu said. The church has since replaced the anniversary mass with a general ceremony for “the brothers and sisters who died in the past year,” according to a Facebook post on Tuesday. “As a churchgoer, I respect the church’s decision. But I’d like to ask: do police now have the power to dictate who believers pray for?” Yiu wrote . In a screenshot of the since-deleted social media post, the church had written: “It is almost the one-year anniversary of the Wang Fuk Court fire in Tai Po. The sorrow still lingers.” Wang Fuk Court seen in the distance on April 20, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. “With November being the month of remembrance in the Catholic Church, we pray for the eternal rest of the deceased… we ask God for mercy, compassion and blessing.” ‘In accordance with the law’ Separately, a church in Wan Chai – Our Lady of Mount Carmel – also planned a memorial mass marking one year since the deadly fire, local media reported citing churchgoers. The church, however, did not publicise the mass. On a Commercial Radio show on Tuesday, Our Lady of Mount Carmel parish priest Father Thomas Law said November was a month of remembrance for the Catholic community, and that the church held such a memorial every year. Fr. Thomas Law, parish priest of Our Lady of Mount Carmel Church in Wan Chai. Photo: Thomas Law, via Facebook. Asked whether the mass would address victims of the Tai Po fire, Law said that anyone who wished to pray for them might do so, and that there was “no need to add or subtract.” He said he had not been contacted by police. But hours after the radio segment aired, reporters learned from Law that he had since been questioned by three police officers asking about details of the mass and how many people would attend. Law said that police did not threaten him, and that they were just concerned and “curious.” Police said in response to HKFP that officers would “act in accordance with the law based on actual circumstances and maintain communication with organisers where necessary” when handling events. Secretary for Security Chris Tang said on a television programme last week that he understood the desire of victims’ families to mark the anniversary. He said that as long as they abided by the law , authorities would “definitely assist.” Asked if police had received applications for memorial events, Tang said only that police would consider factors including the safety of the venue and families’ wishes.

title: President Trump says Apple’s Tim Cook is the only man to replace Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO
zh_title: 特朗普总统表示，苹果公司的蒂姆·库克是唯一接替黄仁勋出任英伟达首席执行官的人
summary: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，退休的苹果首席执行官蒂姆·库克应该接替黄仁勋担任英伟达首席执行官，就在黄仁勋因一系列丑闻而辞职的消息宣布几小时后。总统在他的真相社交平台上表示，“现在英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋已经辞职，他的工作非常出色，只有一个人可以接替他的位置——苹果公司的蒂姆·库克。传奇取代传奇！总统唐纳德·J·特朗普。”英伟达董事会周三宣布，因婚外情被曝光，黄仁勋已辞职
content:
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，退休的苹果首席执行官蒂姆·库克应该接替黄仁勋担任英伟达首席执行官，就在黄仁勋因一系列丑闻而辞职的消息宣布几小时后。总统在他的真相社交平台上表示，“现在英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋已经辞职，他的工作非常出色，只有一个人可以接替他的位置——苹果公司的蒂姆·库克。传奇取代传奇！总统唐纳德·J·特朗普。”英伟达董事会周三宣布，黄仁勋因与一名涉嫌中国情报人员的 Megaspeed 高管发生婚外情以及与英伟达医疗保健副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔 (Kimberly Powell) 发生婚外情而辞职。执行副总裁兼首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 将在公司寻找替代者期间担任临时首席执行官。当然，潜在的继任者候选人的名字已经浮出水面，其中包括苹果首席硬件官约翰尼·斯鲁吉(Johny Srouji)。由于英伟达处于全球人工智能爆发的中心，黄仁勋和特朗普的关系密切，经常成为新闻头条。特朗普此前曾形容黄仁勋对于关税和废除拜登总统的人工智能扩散规则的看法“非常有远见”。正在发生的黄事件丑闻中提到了特朗普总统的名字。值得注意的是，据称，虽然美国
情报认为黄仁勋是中国蜜罐行动的目标，有报道称特朗普总统已听取了此事的简报，但选择不对这些信息采取任何行动，以免影响英伟达的销售或与中国对抗。国会已传唤黄仁勋出席中共特别委员会，议员们威胁如果黄仁勋不同意自愿参加闭门会议，将向他发出传票。蒂姆·库克目前担任苹果公司董事会执行主席，曾于 2011 年至 2026 年担任该公司首席执行官。在他任职期间，他负责监督 Apple Music 和 Apple TV 等众多 Apple 服务的推出，同时扩展到 Apple Watch 和 AirPods 等新产品类别。周三开盘时，英伟达股价暴跌超过 10 个百分点，但由于交易员希望利用英伟达股价下跌的机会，该公司股价收复了大部分失地。该公司将于下周（即 11 月 17 日星期二）公布 2027 财年第三季度财务业绩。

【原文 English Original】
President Donald Trump has said that retired Apple CEO Tim Cook should replace Jensen Huang as the CEO of Nvidia, just hours after it was announced that the latter had resigned in the wake of a series of scandals. Taking to his Truth Social platform, the President said , "NOW THAT Nvidia CEO JENSEN HUANG, who has done a fantastic job, has resigned, there is only one man to take his place - TIM COOK of Apple. A Legend replaces a Legend! President DONALD J. TRUMP." Nvidia's board of directors announced on Wednesday that Huang had resigned following the revelation that he conducted an extramarital affair with a Megaspeed executive suspected of being a Chinese intelligence asset , and a further affair with Nvidia Vice President of Health Care, Kimberly Powell. Colette Kress, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, will serve as Interim CEO while the company looks for a replacement. Naturally, names have been floated as potential successor candidates, including Apple's Chief Hardware Officer Johny Srouji. With Nvidia at the center of the global explosion in AI, Huang and Trump have enjoyed a close relationship that routinely makes news headlines. Trump previously described Huang as 'utterly visionary' in regard to his views on tariffs and rescinding President Biden's AI Diffusion Rule . President Trump's name has been mentioned in the ongoing Huang affair scandal. Notably, it is alleged that while U.S. intelligence believed that Huang had been the target of a Chinese honeypot operation , reports claim that President Trump was briefed on the matter but chose not to do anything with the information, so as not to affect Nvidia's sales or antagonize China. Congress has summoned Jensen Huang to appear before the Select Committee on the CCP , with lawmakers threatening to issue Huang with a subpoena if he doesn't agree to attend a closed-door meeting voluntarily. Tim Cook is currently the Executive Chair of Apple's board, having served as the company's CEO from 2011 to 2026. During his tenure, he oversaw the launch of a plethora of Apple services, including Apple Music and Apple TV, while expanding into new product categories such as Apple Watch and AirPods. Nvidia's share price plunged more than 10 percentage points at the open on Wednesday, but recovered much of that ground as traders looked to take advantage of the dip in Nvidia's share price. The company will report its third-quarter fiscal 2027 financial results next week, on Tuesday, November 17.

title: Hong Kong Judiciary issues binding rules making litigation ‘last resort’ for Wang Fuk Court fire claims
zh_title: 香港司法机构发布具有约束力的规则，使诉讼成为宏福法院火灾索赔的“最后手段”
summary: 香港司法机构发布了一套具有约束力的程序规则，要求受火灾影响的宏福苑的前居民在向香港法院正式提出民事索赔之前，必须用尽其他赔偿选择，作为“最后的手段”。宏福苑，2026 年 8 月 20 日。摄影：Kyle Lam。司法机构在周四的一份声明中表示，由于去年 11 月的致命火灾造成“大量人员伤亡和严重损害”，“涉及复杂问题和巨额金额的大量索赔可能很快就会提交法院”。 “考虑到时间、成本和不确定性
content:
香港司法机构发布了一套具有约束力的程序规则，要求受火灾影响的宏福苑的前居民在向香港法院正式提出民事索赔之前，必须用尽其他赔偿选择，作为“最后的手段”。宏福苑，2026 年 8 月 20 日。摄影：Kyle Lam。司法机构在周四的一份声明中表示，由于去年 11 月的致命火灾造成“大量人员伤亡和严重损害”，“涉及复杂问题和巨额金额的大量索赔可能很快就会提交法院”。 “考虑到诉讼所涉及的时间、成本和不确定性，”它表示，首先通过和解或调解解决索赔将符合当事人和公众的利益，而诉讼是最后的手段。声明称，新规则以两套“特别实践说明”的形式立即生效。 “最后手段” 据司法机构称，实践指引旨在“确保司法资源的公平和按比例分配，同时不损害当事人诉诸法庭和公平审判的权利”。宏福苑火灾引起的索赔应首先通过和解方式解决，否则各方应采取调解等其他争议解决方式。它说，诉讼只能是“最后的手段”。
在谈判和争议解决过程中，“当事人应尽最大努力，做出真诚和善意的努力”，而“当且仅当”这些努力未能解决争议时，才应提起诉讼。司法机构。照片：何凯莉/HKFP。当事人还必须向法院解释调解失败的原因以及仍然存在的争议点。如果一方绕过调解而直接向区域法院或高等法院原讼法庭提出申索，法院可将诉讼程序搁置最多六个月，以便双方尝试调解。至于雇员补偿索偿及小额钱债审裁处的案件，诉讼程序也可能会押后约四个月，以方便和解或调解。如果这些解决方案尝试不成功，则将在未来六到九个月内安排针对员工赔偿的听证会，并在四个月内针对小额索赔法庭安排听证会。香港大律师公会调解委员会主席凌俊伟向《明报》表示，虽然操作指引提出了新要求，但“不会阻止你提起诉讼”。他还表示，值得考虑诉讼权利是否受到影响，同时指出新要求并没有过度限制，并指出根据标准民事审判程序至少需要等待六个月才能安排听证会日期。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong’s Judiciary has issued a set of binding procedural rules requiring former residents of the fire-hit Wang Fuk Court to exhaust other options for compensation before formally filing civil claims at the city’s courts as a “last resort.” Wang Fuk Court on August 20, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam. The Judiciary said in a Thursday statement that “a large number of claims involving complex issues and substantial sums may soon be brought before the courts” owing to the “extensive casualties and severe damage” caused by the deadly blaze last November. “Bearing in mind the time, costs and uncertainties involved in litigation,” it said that resolving claims initially through settlement or mediation would serve the interests of the parties and the public, with litigation as a last resort. The new rules, taking the form of two sets of “Special Practice Notes,” have taken immediate effect, according to the statement. ‘Last resort’ According to the Judiciary, the practice notes intend “to ensure a fair and proportionate distribution of judicial resources without impairing the parties’ right to access to court and a fair trial.” It said that claims arising from the Wang Fuk Court fire should be resolved first by settlement, failing which parties should proceed with alternative dispute resolution methods such as mediation. Litigation should only be a “last resort,” it said. “The parties shall use their best endeavours and make genuine and bona fide efforts” in the negotiation and dispute resolution processes, while litigation should be commenced “if and only if” those efforts failed to resolve the dispute. The Judiciary. Photo: Kelly Ho/HKFP. Parties must also explain to the court their reasons for failed mediation and the points of dispute that remain. If a party bypasses mediation and files a claim directly with the District Court or the Court of First Instance of the High Court, the court may put proceedings on hold for up to six months to allow the parties to attempt mediation. For Employees’ Compensation claims and cases in the Small Claims Tribunal, proceedings may also be adjourned for about four months to facilitate settlement or mediation. If those resolution attempts are unsuccessful, hearings will be scheduled within the next six to nine months for Employees’ Compensation and within four months for the Small Claims Tribunal. Chairman of the Hong Kong Bar Association’s Committee on Mediation Ling Chun-wai told Ming Pao that while the practice notes impose new requirements, they “will not stop you from litigating.” He was also quoted as saying that it was worth considering whether the right to litigate had been affected, while noting that the new requirements were not overly restrictive, pointing to the wait of at least six months to have a hearing date scheduled under standard civil trial procedures.

content:
以下是上周西太平洋主要舰船活动和演习的摘要。 2026 年 11 月 9 日，新加坡，一名隶属于第 137 电子攻击中队 (VAQ) 的美国水手在尼米兹级航空母舰西奥多·罗斯福号 (CVN-71) 机库湾对 E/A-18G 咆哮者进行维护。美国海军照片 西奥多·罗斯福号航母打击群于周日从新加坡出发。该打击群包括西奥多·罗斯福号航空母舰（CVN-71）及其第11舰载机联队（CVW）、长津号巡洋舰（CG-65）以及保罗·汉密尔顿号驱逐舰（DDG-60）和迪凯特号（DDG-73）。西奥多·罗斯福、长津和迪凯特向西航行进入马六甲海峡，而保罗·汉密尔顿则向东航行进入南中国海。西奥多·罗斯福号、长津号和迪凯特号目前正在印度洋前往美国中央司令部。日本横须贺附近 印度海军 Shivalik 级隐形多用途护卫舰 INS Sahyadri (F 49)、日本海上自卫队日向级直升机驱逐舰 JS Ise (DDH 182)、最上级护卫舰 JS Mogami (FFM 1)、澳大利亚皇家海军安扎克级护卫舰 HMAS Stuart (FFH 153) 和美国海军 San 2026 年 11 月 7 日，安东尼奥级两栖运输船坞运输舰安克雷奇号 (LPD-23) 和约翰·穆萨号 (LPD-26) 在 2026 年马拉巴尔演习期间在西太平洋编队航行。美国海军照片 2026 年马拉巴尔四方演习于周四在日本横须贺附近海域结束。
参与的资产包括日本海上自卫队直升机驱逐舰 JS Ise (DDH-182)、护卫舰 JS Mogami (FFM-1)、日本海上自卫队潜艇和 P-1 海上巡逻机 (MPA)、印度海军护卫舰 INS Sahyadri (F49)、澳大利亚皇家海军护卫舰 HMAS Stuart (FFH153) 和澳大利亚皇家空军 P-8A Poseidon MPA、美国海军 P-8A 海神 MPA 和两栖运输船坞 USS Anchorage (LPD-23) 和 USS John P. Murtha (LPD-26)。安克雷奇号和约翰·P·穆萨号与两栖攻击舰马金岛号 (LHD-8) 以及已登船的第 13 海军陆战队远征部队组成了马金岛两栖待命大队。据当地船舶观察员称，这三艘船均于周六从横须贺舰队活动司令部（CFAY）出发。 2026 年 11 月 8 日，在日本横须贺，美国海军陆战队海军陆战队海军陆战队中型倾转旋翼机中队 (VMM) 364（加强型）的飞行员从圣安东尼奥级两栖运输船坞舰安克雷奇 (LPD-23) 的飞行甲板上驾驶一架 MV-22B 鱼鹰。美国海军照片安克雷奇于周五返回横须贺，目前停泊据当地船舶观察员称，那里近海。据当地船舶观察员称，澳大利亚皇家海军斯图尔特号护卫舰在参加 2026 年马拉巴尔演习后于周四返回横须贺。据当地船舶观察员称，印度海军护卫舰 INS Sahyadri 于周四返回横须贺，并于周五离开。
据当地船舶观测员称，潜艇补给船弗兰克·凯布尔号 (AS-40) 于周三驶入横须贺指挥官舰队活动基地。在西太平洋，隶属于海军陆战队中型倾转旋翼机中队 (VMM) 364 的美国海军陆战队 CH-53 种马准备从圣安东尼奥级两栖运输船坞舰约翰·P·穆萨号 (LPD-26) 的飞行甲板起飞， 2026 年 11 月 9 日。美国海军照片 两栖攻击舰马金岛号和两栖运输船坞约翰·P·穆萨号正在美国第七舰队作战区域航行。在菲律宾海 台湾民族党秘书长吴钊燮于 2026 年 11 月 12 日发布的图片

The following is a summary of major ship movements and exercises in the Western Pacific over the last week. In Singapore A U.S. sailor assigned to Electronic Attack Squadron (VAQ) 137 conducts maintenance on an E/A-18G Growler in the hangar bay of Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71), Nov. 9, 2026. US Navy photo The Theodore Roosevelt Carrier Strike Group departed on Sunday from Singapore. The strike group includes aircraft carrier USS Theodore Roosevelt (CVN-71) with embarked carrier air wing (CVW) 11, cruiser USS Chosin (CG-65) and destroyers USS Paul Hamilton (DDG-60) and USS Decatur (DDG-73). Theodore Roosevelt , Chosin and Decatur sailed west to enter the Malacca Strait while Paul Hamilton sailed east into the South China Sea. Theodore Roosevelt , Chosin and Decatur are now in the Indian Ocean en route to U.S. Central Command. Near Yokosuka, Japan Indian Navy Shivalik-class stealth multi-role frigate INS Sahyadri (F 49), Japan Maritime Self-Defense Force Hyuga-class helicopter destroyer JS Ise (DDH 182), Mogami-class frigate JS Mogami (FFM 1), Royal Australian Navy Anzac-class frigate HMAS Stuart (FFH 153) and U.S. Navy San Antonio-class amphibious transport docks USS Anchorage (LPD-23) and USS John P. Murtha (LPD-26) sail in formation in the Western Pacific Ocean during Exercise Malabar 2026, Nov. 7, 2026. US Navy photo Quad Exercise Malabar 2026 wrapped up Thursday in the waters near Yokosuka, Japan. Participating assets were Japan Maritime Self Defense Force helicopter destroyer JS Ise (DDH-182), frigate JS Mogami (FFM-1), a JMSDF submarine and a P-1 Maritime Patrol Aircraft (MPA), Indian Navy frigate INS Sahyadri (F49), Royal Australian Navy frigate HMAS Stuart (FFH153) and a Royal Australian Air Force P-8A Poseidon MPA, a U.S. Navy P-8A Poseidon MPA and amphibious transport docks USS Anchorage (LPD-23) and USS John P. Murtha (LPD-26). Anchorage and John P. Murtha with amphibious assault ship USS Makin Island (LHD-8) and the embarked 13th Marine Expeditionary Unit form the Makin Island Amphibious Ready Group. All three ships departed Saturday from Commander Fleet Activities Yokosuka (CFAY), according to local ship spotters . In Yokosuka, Japan U.S. Marine Corps Marines, pilots assigned to Marine Medium Tiltrotor Squadron (VMM) 364 (Reinforced), fly an MV-22B Osprey from the flight deck aboard San Antonio-class amphibious transport dock ship USS Anchorage (LPD-23), Nov. 8, 2026. US Navy photo Anchorage returned to Yokosuka on Friday and is currently anchored offshore there, according to local ship spotters . RAN frigate HMAS Stuart returned on Thursday to Yokosuka after its participation in Exercise Malabar 2026, according to local ship spotters . Indian Navy frigate INS Sahyadri returned on Thursday to Yokosuka and departed on Friday, according to local ship spotters . Submarine tender USS Frank Cable (AS-40) pulled into Commander Fleet Activities Yokosuka on Wednesday, according to local ship spotters . In the Western Pacific A U.S. Marine Corps CH-53 Stallion, attached to Marine Medium Tiltrotor Squadron (VMM) 364, prepares to take off from the flight deck aboard San Antonio-class amphibious transport dock ship USS John P. Murtha (LPD-26), Nov. 9, 2026. US Navy photo Amphibious assault ship Makin Island and amphibious transport dock John P. Murtha are underway in U.S. 7th Fleet area of operations. In the Philippine Sea A graphic posted Nov. 12, 2026, by Joseph Wu, Secretary General of Taiwan’s National Security Council. Taiwan National Security Council graphic The People’s Liberation Army Navy Liaoning CSG is operating in the Philippine Sea waters east of the Philippine island of Samar as of Thursday, according to a graphic posted by Joseph Wu, Secretary General of Taiwan’s National Security Council. The CSG was last visually sighted in October. The Liaoning CSG previously included aircraft carrier CNS Liaoning (16) cruisers CNS Anshan (101) and CNS Wuxi (104) and destroyer CNS Huainan (123) but the accompanying ships to the carrier may have changed since. In the South China Sea (L-R) Able Seaman Maritime Logistic – Supply Chain Leah Locke and Able Seaman Maritime Logistic – Supply Chain Grace Reading lay wreaths during a wreath laying ceremony for Remembrance Day during a Regional Presence Deployment 2026 on Nov. 10, 2026. Australian Defense photo Royal Australian Navy fleet oiler HMAS Stalwart (A304) is operating in the South China Sea waters near Brunei on the Royal Australian Navy’s regional presence deployment. On Wednesday , the ship conducted a Remembrance Day wreath laying ceremony with Royal Brunei Navy offshore patrol vessel KDB Darulaman (08). In Guam The ROKN Joint Cruise Training Task Force, 741 second year cadets from three service academies and the Armed Forces Nursing Academy were in Guam for a port visit on Nov. 9, 2026. US Navy photo The ROKN Joint Cruise Training Task Force, 741 second year cadets from three service academies and the Armed Forces Nursing Academy were in Guam as of Monday on a port visit. The task force includes amphibious assault ship ROKS Marado (LPH-6112) and amphibious landing ships ROKS Ilchulbong (LST-688) and ROKS Nojeokbong (LST-689), along with embarked Republic of Korea Marine Corps (ROKMC) MUH-1 Marineon helicopters. In Kangwon Province, North Korea North Korea leader Kim Jong Un inspected the construction site of a new naval base on Nov. 11, 2026, in Thongchon County, Kangwon Province. State media Korea Central News Agency photo North Korea leader Kim Jong Un inspected the construction site of a new naval base on Wednesday in Thongchon County, Kangwon Province, located on North Korea’s east coast, state media Korean Central News Agency reported. In Maizuru, Japan Royal Navy offshore patrol vessel HMS Spey (P234) departed JMSDF Maizuru Naval Base on Nov. 10, 2026. JMSDF photo Royal Navy offshore patrol vessel HMS Spey (P234) departed JMSDF Maizuru Naval Base on Tuesday after completing a five-day port visit that began on Nov. 6. Spey with sister ship HMS Tamar (P233) are forwarded deployed to the Indo-Pacific. Near Yonaguni Island and Taiwan A Chinese BZK-005 reconnaissance UAV on Nov. 11, 2026. Japan Joint Staff Office photo On Wednesday, a suspected Chinese Unmanned Aerial Vehicle flew in from the East China Sea, passed between Yonaguni Island and Taiwan and reached the Philippine Sea. The UAV then turned back when it reached a point east of the northeast tip of Taiwan and flew between Yonaguni Island and Taiwan to return to the East China Sea. Fighter aircraft from the Japan Air Self-Defense Force Southwestern Air Defense Command were scrambled in response. Also on Wednesday, a Chinese BZK-005 reconnaissance UAV flew in from the East China Sea, passing between Yonaguni Island and Taiwan to enter the Philippine Sea. The drone then flew south until it was east of the northwest tip of Taiwan and conducted a circuit flight before returning back the same way to the East China Sea. JASDF fighter aircraft from the JASDF Southwestern Air Defense Command were scrambled in response. Suspected Chinese UAV flight paths on Nov. 11, 2026. Japan Joint Staff Office map On Thursday, a suspected Chinese UAV flew in from the East China Sea and entered the Philippine Sea, flying between Yonaguni Island and Taiwan. The suspected drone was east of the northeast tip of Taiwan before its track was lost. Later that same day, another suspected Chinese UAV was tracked from the Philippine Sea east of the northeast tip of Taiwan. The UAV flew north and entered the East China Sea after flying between Yonaguni Island and Taiwan. Japan’s Joint Staff Office issued a news release on the flights, indicating the flights were conducted by different UAVs. Fighter aircraft from the JASDF Southwestern Air Defense Command were scrambled to intercept. In the East China Sea A Chinese Y-9 Electronic Intelligence aircraft on Nov. 10, 2026. Japan Joint Staff Office photo On Tuesday, a Chinese Y-9 Electronic Intelligence aircraft flew in from China and flew from an area south of the Danjo Islands in the East China Sea to a position northwest of Okinawa. After completing a patrol circuit, the Y-9 flew back to China. In response, JASDF fighter aircraft were scrambled. In the Miyako Strait PLAN destroyer CNS Qiqihar (121) and fast combat support ship CNS Hulunhu (901) on Nov. 10, 2026. Japan Joint Staff Office photo PLAN destroyer CNS Qiqihar (121) and fast combat support ship CNS Hulunhu (901) were spotted on Thursday sailing south 60 kilometers – 37 miles – west of Kume Island. The ships sailed southeast between Okinawa and Miyako Island to enter the Philippine Sea. A JMSDF P-1 MPA of Fleet Air Wing 1 and a JMSDF P-3C Orion MPA shadowed the PLAN ships. In La Pérouse Strait A Russian Navy Kilo-class submarine, amphibious landing ship RFS Nikolai Vilkov (081) and tugboat Fotiy Krylov on Nov. 10, 2026. Japan Joint Staff Office photo A Russian Navy Kilo-class submarine, amphibious landing ship RFS Nikolai Vilkov (081) and tugboat Fotiy Krylov were sighted sailing west 40 kilometers – 25 miles – northeast of Cape Soya on the main island of Hokkaido late Tuesday. From Tuesday to Wednesday, the submarine and ships sailed west through La Pérouse Strait, which separates Hokkaido from Russia’s Sakhalin Island, to enter the Sea of Japan. JMSDF fast attack craft JS Umitaka (PG-828) and a JMSDF P-3C Orion MPA shadowed the Russian submarine and ships. This post was written by Dzirhan Mahadzir.

zh_title: 马来西亚和新加坡在黄仁勋争议中加大对 Nvidia AI 芯片的调查
summary: 由于担心可能规避美国对中国的出口限制，马来西亚和新加坡加强了对人工智能硬件运输的审查。据路透社报道，马来西亚已对命运多舛的 Megaspeed 子公司进口的人工智能硬件是否随后出口到其他国家展开调查。与此同时，据《海峡时报》报道，新加坡已对另一名高管提出指控，指控其购买的 917 台服务器存在问题，这些服务器可能包含 Nvidia 加速器。此前，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋因声称拥有多个额外职位而辞职。
content:
由于担心可能规避美国对中国的出口限制，马来西亚和新加坡加强了对人工智能硬件运输的审查。据路透社报道，马来西亚已对命运多舛的 Megaspeed 子公司进口的人工智能硬件是否随后出口到其他国家展开调查。与此同时，据《海峡时报》报道，新加坡已对另一名高管提出指控，指控其购买的 917 台服务器存在问题，这些服务器可能包含 Nvidia 加速器。在此消息发布之前，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋因声称自己有多次婚外情而辞职，其中包括与一名可能协助 GPU 走私到中国的中国情报人员发生婚外情。分析人士推测，系统性芯片走私可能是他离职的原因。深入了解 TH Premium：台湾、贸易和关税（图片来源：台积电） 虽然美国在芯片制裁上反复无常，但中国正在建立自己的芯片供应市场 中国长达十年的半导体推动状况 华为 Ascend NPU 路线图审查了中国长鑫存储的目标，到 2030 年，第六座大型晶圆厂将占据 30% 的 DRAM 内存市场份额 中国最新一轮稀土出口管制解释说，马来西亚投资、贸易和工业部正在研究是否总部位于新加坡的 Megaspeed 的马来西亚子公司 Speedmatrix 重新出口了其进口的所有人工智能处理器和服务器，供当地数据中心使用。
显然，经过数月的调查，当局尚未查明是否发生过此类运输，如果发生过，是否符合马来西亚法律。马来西亚于 2025 年 7 月对美国开发的先进人工智能加速器的出口、过境和转运实施了限制，因此现在要求公司获得适当的许可证。马来西亚外交部表示，正在与海关当局以及新加坡和美国的官员合作，并可能推出额外的限制。总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣表示，没有证据表明与 Megaspeed 相关的人工智能硬件已离开马来西亚，但他承诺配合国际调查。据 DigiTimes 报道，谈到 Megaspeed，该公司于 11 月 12 日表示，已聘请一家美国律师事务所对其 AI GPU 进行全面清查，并独立评估其对美国出口管制法规的遵守情况。该公司还证实，已配合美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）的检查，并准备在必要时与其他美国政府机构合作。 Megaspeed 首席执行官 James Tan Yong Pong 强调，遵守美国出口规则以及透明运营始终是该公司的首要任务。
不过，Megaspeed没有透露其拥有多少GPU、有哪些GPU型号、BIS在检查时检查了哪些内容，也没有透露当局是否发现任何违规行为。 与此同时，新加坡当局已对曾担任Superphi董事、NJ Global Financial首席运营官的34岁中国公民石秉哲提出41项刑事指控。检察官称，这两家公司在 2024 年 5 月至 2025 年 2 月期间通过 41 笔交易从 Aperia International 购买了 917 台包含受限 Nvidia 硬件的服务器。当局声称，这些公司有理由相信这些服务器与 Aperia International 的犯罪活动有关。 Superphi现在面临

【原文 English Original】
Malaysia and Singapore have intensified scrutiny of AI hardware shipments amid concerns about the potential circumvention of U.S. export restrictions on China. Malaysia has launched an investigation into whether AI hardware imported by a subsidiary of the ill-fated Megaspeed was subsequently exported to other countries, reports Reuters . Meanwhile, Singapore has charged another executive over questionable purchases of 917 servers that may contain Nvidia accelerators, according to The Straits Times . The news follows the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang over claims he had multiple extra-marital affairs , including with a possible Chinese intelligence asset who facilitated GPU smuggling into China. Analysts speculate that systematic chip smuggling may be the reason behind his departure . Go deeper with TH Premium: Taiwan, trade, and tariffs (Image credit: tsmc) While the U.S. flip-flops on chip sanctions, China is building its own chip supply market The state of China's decade-long semiconductor push Huawei Ascend NPU roadmap examined China's CXMT targets 30% DRAM memory market share by 2030 with sixth mega-fab China's latest round of rare-earth export controls explained Malaysia's Ministry of Investment, Trade and Industry is examining whether Speedmatrix, the Malaysian subsidiary of Singapore-based Megaspeed , re-exported any of the AI processors and servers it had imported for use in local data centers. Apparently, after months of investigating, authorities have yet to find out whether any such shipments occurred and, if they did, whether they complied with Malaysian laws. Malaysia introduced restrictions on the export, transit, and trans-shipment of advanced U.S.-developed AI accelerators in July 2025, so it now requires companies to obtain appropriate permits. The Malaysian ministry said it was cooperating with customs authorities as well as officials in Singapore and the U.S., and could introduce additional restrictions. Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said there was no evidence that Megaspeed-related AI hardware had left Malaysia, but he promised to cooperate with international investigations. Speaking of Megaspeed, the company said on November 12 that it had hired a U.S. law firm to conduct a comprehensive inventory of its AI GPUs and independently assess its compliance with U.S. export-control regulations, reports DigiTimes . The company also confirmed that it had cooperated with inspections by the U.S. Department of Commerce's Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) and was prepared to cooperate with other U.S. government agencies if necessary. James Tan Yong Pong, chief executive of Megaspeed, stressed that compliance with U.S. export rules as well as transparent operations were always a priority for the company. However, Megaspeed did not disclose how many GPUs it owns and which GPU models it has, what BIS examined during its inspections, or whether the authorities had identified any violations. Meanwhile, Singaporean authorities have brought 41 criminal charges against Shi Bingzhe, a 34-year-old Chinese citizen who served as director of Superphi and chief operating officer of NJ Global Financial. The two companies purchased 917 servers containing restricted Nvidia hardware from Aperia International in 41 transactions between May 2024 and February 2025, according to prosecutors. Authorities allege that the companies had reason to believe the servers were linked to criminal activity by Aperia International. Superphi now faces six charges, while NJ Global Financial faces 35. The latest charges expand a case that now involves five individuals and six companies. Four firms — Aperia International, A-Speed Infotech, Aperia Cloud Services (II), and Luxuriate Your Life — were charged in July over allegedly making false claims when purchasing servers. Meanwhile, the exact nature of those claims was not disclosed in the report. Authorities have frozen the disposal of a property worth approximately S$55 million and confiscated around S$1 million from bank accounts. Shi faces up to 10 years in prison and a fine of S$500,000 per charge if convicted. His next court appearance is scheduled for January 4, 2027. The two cases largely highlight the significance of Malaysia and Singapore in the supply chain of restricted AI hardware to places where it should not be, such as China. Singapore's investigation focuses on alleged fraud and transactions involving proceeds of criminal activity, whereas Malaysia seeks to find out whether imported AI equipment was subsequently shipped abroad in violation of local regulations. Neither investigation has found that the hardware ultimately reached China, but both illustrate difficulties that authorities face as they attempt to enforce restrictions on advanced AI hardware across international supply chains.

title: Long-awaited Hong Kong sex offences reform bill to be gazetted Friday
zh_title: 期待已久的香港性犯罪改革法案将于周五刊宪
summary: 一系列期待已久的性犯罪改革，包括将持续性儿童性虐待和“网络闪光”定为刑事犯罪，已定于本周五在宪报刊登，该法案将于本月晚些时候在立法机关进行审查。由针对妇女的性暴力协会出版的关于性侵犯和性法律改革的小册子。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 《2026年性罪行法例（修订）条例草案》旨在实现两项政策目标，即加强对性罪行受害者的保护，以及使香港有关性罪行的法律现代化，以跟上时代的步伐。
content:
一系列期待已久的性犯罪改革，包括将持续性儿童性虐待和“网络闪光”定为刑事犯罪，已定于本周五在宪报刊登，该法案将于本月晚些时候在立法机关进行审查。由针对妇女的性暴力协会出版的关于性侵犯和性法律改革的小册子。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。保安局在周三的一份声明中表示，《2026年性犯罪法例（修订）条例草案》旨在实现两个政策目标，即加强对性犯罪受害者的保护，以及使香港有关性犯罪的法律与时俱进。报告称，改革旨在审查该市已有数十年历史的性犯罪法律并使其更新，“以解决现行规定的不足之处，并应对与性犯罪有关的社会观念的变化”。 “与时俱进” 该法律草案将于本周五在政府公报上公布，然后于11月25日提交立法会。政府的目标是在明年6月本届任期结束前完成立法工作。该局发言人表示：“我们希望完善香港有关性犯罪的法律，越早越好，加强对性犯罪受害者的保护，同时确保有关性犯罪的法律能够与时俱进。”香港立法会。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。
这项立法改革在今年 7 月首次提出时，遭到了要求加强保护的呼声，其中包括缺乏持续的儿童性虐待罪。在这些呼声之后，政府于 9 月提议制定新的罪行，将长期和反复性虐待儿童以及未经同意发送生殖器数码照片（称为“网络闪光”）定为刑事犯罪。作为性犯罪改革的一部分，政府提出了两种新的罪行来代替非礼：涉及触摸的性侵犯和不触摸的性侵犯。它还寻求扩大强奸的范围，以涵盖男性和变性幸存者。与此同时，倡导团体继续呼吁政府对允许性侵犯嫌疑人声称他们错误地认为自己已获得同意的辩护施加限制。

【原文 English Original】
A long-awaited slate of sex crime reforms including the criminalisation of persistent child sexual abuse and “cyberflashing” has been set to be gazetted this Friday, with the bill due for scrutiny at the legislature later this month. Booklets published by Association Concerning Sexual Violence Against Women on sexual assault and sexual law reform. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The Sexual Offences Legislation (Amendment) Bill 2026 “aims to achieve two policy objectives, namely, strengthening protection for victims of sexual offences, and modernising the laws on sexual offences in Hong Kong to keep pace with the times,” the Security Bureau said in a Wednesday statement. The reforms aim to review the city’s decades-old sex crimes laws and bring them up to date, “to address the inadequacies of the current provisions and respond to changes in social perceptions related to sexual offences,” it said. ‘Keep pace with the times’ The draft law will be published in the government gazette this Friday before being introduced to the Legislative Council on November 25. The government aims to complete the legislative exercise before its current term ends in June next year. “We hope to improve the laws on sexual offences in Hong Kong, the earlier the better, to strengthen protection for victims of sexual offences while ensuring that the laws on sexual offences can keep pace with the times,” the bureau’s spokesperson said. Hong Kong Legislative Council. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The legislative revamp was met with calls for stronger protections when it was first put forward this July, including over its lack of a persistent child sexual abuse offence. Following those calls, the government in September proposed creating new offences to criminalise prolonged and repeated sexual abuse against children as well as sending digital pictures of one’s genitals without consent, known as “cyberflashing.” As part of the sex crime reforms, the government has proposed two new offences in place of indecent assault: sexual assault involving touching and sexual assault without touching. It also seeks to expand the scope of rape to cover male and transgender survivors. Meanwhile, advocacy groups have continued to call on the government to impose limits on a defence allowing a sexual assault suspect to claim they mistakenly believed they had been given consent.

title: Hong Kong receives 16 expressions of interest for Northern Metropolis logistics cluster
zh_title: 香港收到16份发展北都物流集群的意向书
summary: 政府表示，香港北部都会洪水桥/厦村发展区规划中的物流集群已收到 16 份意向书。这张航拍照片显示的是2026年10月30日，即将建成的洪水桥地铁站附近的益园村正在被拆除。照片的右上角显示了洪水桥大学城校园区规划的大片区域。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。当局周五宣布，这 16 份意见书来自开发商、物流运营商、行业协会和专业服务机构。
content:
政府表示，香港北部都会洪水桥/厦村发展区规划中的物流集群已收到 16 份意向书。这张航拍照片显示的是2026年10月30日，即将建成的洪水桥地铁站附近的益园村正在被拆除。照片的右上角显示了洪水桥大学城校园区规划的大片区域。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。当局周五宣布，这 16 份意见书来自开发商、物流运营商、行业协会和专业服务提供商，但没有透露具体姓名。他们表示对洪水桥/厦村新发展区一块约32公顷的土地感兴趣，当局已预留该土地用于在北方大都市西部建设“现代物流集群”。运输及物流局和土木工程拓展署负责监管这部分工程。 TLB 发言人表示，当局将开始分析提交的材料，以促进正式招标的规划和准备。该发言人补充道：“我们预计最早将于 2027 年底对第一批可用场地进行招标，并争取在 2028 年授予相关招标。”
政府表示，洪水桥/厦村物流集群将靠近深圳湾口岸，并连接香港国际机场和葵青货柜码头。立法会周四通过专门立法，简化监管程序并加快北部都会区的发展，该计划将把靠近深圳边境的香港约三分之一的土地转变为创新和科技中心。另请参阅：科技城到大学城：香港北部大都市为何将重点从高科技转向高等教育 当局表示，该大型项目的重点将是三个大学城，而之前提出的开发名为新田科技城的科技中心的要求则有所不同。

【原文 English Original】
A planned logistics cluster in the Hung Shui Kiu/Ha Tsuen development area in Hong Kong’s Northern Metropolis has received 16 expression-of-interest submissions, the government has said. This aerial photo shows the demolition of Yik Yuen Tsuen, a village near the future Hung Shui Kiu MTR station, October 30, 2026. On the top right corner of the photo shows a large area planned for the campus area of the Hung Shui Kiu University Town. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Authorities announced on Friday that the 16 submissions came from developers, logistics operators, industry associations and professional services providers, without naming them. They were signalling interest in a roughly 32-hectare land plot in the Hung Shui Kiu/Ha Tsuen New Development Area that authorities have reserved for building a “modern logistics cluster” in the western part of the Northern Metropolis. The Transport and Logistics Bureau (TLB) and the Civil Engineering and Development Department oversee this part of the project. A TLB spokesperson said authorities would start analysing the submissions to facilitate planning and the preparation of a formal tender. “We expect to invite tenders for the first available site(s) in end [of] 2027 at the earliest, with a view to awarding the relevant tender in 2028,” the spokesperson added. The Hung Shui Kiu/Ha Tsuen logistics cluster will be close to the Shenzhen Bay Port and connected to the Hong Kong International Airport and the Kwai Tsing Container Terminals, the government has said. Lawmakers on Thursday passed dedicated legislation that will streamline regulatory procedures and expedite the Northern Metropolis development, which is set to transform about a third of Hong Kong’s land area near its border with Shenzhen into an innovation and tech hub. See also: Technopole to University Towns: Why Hong Kong’s Northern Metropolis shifted focus from hi-tech to higher ed Authorities have said that the focus of the megaproject will be three university towns – shifting from the previously stated imperative of developing a tech hub known as the San Tin Technopole.

title: Japan Pledges Drones, Coastal Defense Radar in Latest Philippine Defense Package
zh_title: 日本承诺在菲律宾最新的国防计划中提供无人机和海防雷达
summary: BRP Jose Rizal 与两艘日本海上自卫队舰艇进行演习。菲律宾海军照片 日本将在东京最新的防御计划中向菲律宾军方转让无人机和海岸防御雷达系统，以支持马尼拉的军队。日本驻菲律宾大使北川胜郎和菲律宾外交部长特蕾莎·拉扎罗周一签署了一项协议，涵盖通过官方安全援助计划提供价值高达 2700 万美元的国防转让。此次援助标志着首次通过
content:
BRP Jose Rizal 与两艘日本海上自卫队舰艇进行演习。菲律宾海军照片 日本将在东京最新的防御计划中向菲律宾军方转让无人机和海岸防御雷达系统，以支持马尼拉的军队。日本驻菲律宾大使北川胜郎和菲律宾外交部长特蕾莎·拉扎罗周一签署了一项协议，涵盖通过官方安全援助计划提供价值高达 2700 万美元的国防转让。据日本外务省周一发布的新闻稿称，此次援助标志着首次通过专用海岸雷达系统向菲律宾转移国防设备。该雷达将由菲律宾海军操作，菲律宾海军是日本类似监视系统的先前接收者。上个月在马尼拉举行的日本自卫队成立 72 周年招待会上，日本公司展示了各种打算出售或转让给菲律宾军方的海岸监视系统。这些雷达包括能够跟踪 24 海里外船只的短程系统，以及能够感知 140 海里外海上目标的功能更强大的多用途雷达。除了海域意识援助外，菲律宾空军还将接收型号和数量不详的无人机。 2025年夏天，东京通过OSA向马来西亚转让了14架Aerobo Wing AS-VT02A无人机，价值高达270万美元。
此次移交是马尼拉和东京之间的首次无人移交。此前，日本将TC-90涡轮螺旋桨飞机移交给菲律宾海军航空联队用于海上巡逻。日本大使馆的新闻稿称：“该项目对于进一步促进日本和菲律宾之间的安全合作、加强日本重要海上通道的安全以及维护和加强地区和平与稳定具有重要意义。”近年来，由于对南海和吕宋海峡的共同担忧，东京与马尼拉寻求更密切的防务关系。自 2010 年代以来一些最重要的进展包括承诺为菲律宾海岸警卫队提供 17 艘巡逻舰，以及日本自卫队作战部队抵达东南亚群岛进行演习。今年，日本军队与美国、菲律宾和加拿大军队一起演习，保卫吕宋岛北部的海滩。东京首次全面实战演习以在击沉演习中发射反舰导弹而达到高潮。新的国防装备转让指南也为前日本自卫队装备出售或转让给菲律宾军方开辟了新的机会。目前正在讨论将即将退役的阿巴库巴级护卫舰转移给菲律宾海军。

【原文 English Original】
BRP Jose Rizal conducts exercises with two Japan Maritime Self-Defense ships. Philippine Navy photo Japan will transfer unmanned aerial vehicles and a coastal defense radar system to the Philippine military in Tokyo’s latest defense package to bolster Manila’s forces. Japanese Ambassador to the Philippines Katsuro Kitagawa and Philippine Secretary of Foreign Affairs Theresa Lazaro signed an agreement on Monday covering the defense transfer worth up to $27 million via the Official Security Assistance program. The assistance marks the first transfer of defense equipment to the Philippines via a dedicated coastal radar system, as classified by a Japanese Ministry of Foreign Affairs news release published on Monday. This radar will be operated by the Philippine Navy, which has been the previous recipient of similar surveillance systems from Japan. At the 72nd Japan Self-Defense Force anniversary reception in Manila last month, Japanese firms showcased a variety of coastal watch systems intended for sale or transfer to the Philippine military. These ranged from short-range systems capable of tracking vessels out to 24 nautical miles to more capable multirole radars that can sense maritime targets 140 nautical miles away. Alongside the maritime domain awareness assistance, the Philippine Air Force will receive an unspecified variant and quantity of UAVs. In the summer of 2025, Tokyo transferred 14 Aerobo Wing AS-VT02A UAVs worth up to $2.7 million to Malaysia through OSA. The latest transfer is the first instance of unmanned transfers between Manila and Tokyo. Previously, Japan handed over TC-90 turboprops to the Philippine Naval Air Wing for maritime patrols. “This project is of great importance in further promoting security cooperation between Japan and the Philippines, enhancing security of important sea lanes for Japan, and contributing to maintaining and strengthening regional peace and stability,” reads the Japanese Embassy release. In recent years, Tokyo has pursued closer defense relations with Manila amid mutual concerns over the South China Sea and Luzon Strait. Some of the most significant developments since the 2010s include the commitment of 17 patrol ships for the Philippine Coast Guard and the arrival of Japan Self-Defense Force combat troops for drills across the Southeast Asian archipelago. This year, Japanese troops drilled alongside American, Philippine and Canadian forces to defend a beach in Northern Luzon. Tokyo’s full-scale combat exercise debut culminated with the launch of anti-ship missiles at a sinking exercise. New defense equipment transfer guidelines are also opening up new opportunities for ex-JSDF equipment to be sold or transferred to the Philippine military. Discussions are ongoing to transfer soon-to-be retired Abakumba-class destroyer escorts to the Philippine Navy.

title: U.S. Transfers Unmanned Surface Vessels to Philippine Marine Corps
zh_title: 美国向菲律宾海军陆战队转让无人水面舰艇
summary: 一艘 MARTAC Devil Ray T38 无人水面舰艇。 MARTAC 照片 菲律宾海军陆战队上周在苏比克湾接收了两艘美国制造的无人水面舰艇，这是华盛顿加强马尼拉在南中国海和吕宋海峡的不对称能力的努力的一部分。 11月4日，两艘海上战术系统T38魔鬼鱼无人水面艇被转移到苏比克湾的菲律宾海军陆战队。 PMC 部表示：“今天标志着我们继续努力加强菲律宾海军陆战队能力的又一个有意义的步骤，特别是在群岛海岸防御领域。”
content:
一艘 MARTAC Devil Ray T38 无人水面舰艇。 MARTAC 照片 菲律宾海军陆战队上周在苏比克湾接收了两艘美国制造的无人水面舰艇，这是华盛顿加强马尼拉在南中国海和吕宋海峡的不对称能力的努力的一部分。 11月4日，两艘海上战术系统T38魔鬼鱼无人水面艇被转移到苏比克湾的菲律宾海军陆战队。菲律宾海军陆战队副司令准将说：“今天标志着我们在不断努力加强菲律宾海军陆战队能力方面又迈出了有意义的一步，特别是在群岛海岸防御领域。”根据美国海军学院新闻提供的文字记录，巴亚尼·库拉明将军出席了仪式。据美国海军学院新闻六月报道，菲律宾海军陆战队被定为继菲律宾海军之后下一支接收无人机的部队。马尼拉海军陆战队处于南海争端的最前线，驻守着被大批中国正规军和准军事部队包围的前哨基地。一位熟悉此事的美国国防官员也强调了菲律宾陆军通过该计划接收无人机的可能性。据美国海军学院新闻了解，该部队正在寻求扩大其群岛海岸防御计划中监测和控制受威胁目标的能力。近年来，菲律宾海军陆战队装备了布拉莫斯岸防巡航导弹，并被部署到从苏禄海到吕宋海峡的战略海上交通线上。
横须贺亚太研究委员会东南亚区域项目主任查理·布朗告诉美国海军学院新闻，无人机转移使海军陆战队能够“在广阔且竞争日益激烈的海域”保持意识。布朗说：“这是建立可信的群岛防御能力的一个重要因素：不一定要与对手的平台相匹配，而是利用技术、信息共享和分布式能力使菲律宾的海上途径更加透明，其领土防御更具弹性。”在马尼拉和北京之间因南海争议领土问题出现一系列紧张局势之后，五角大楼正在做出更广泛的努力，以增强菲律宾的领海意识。 2023年以来，中国和菲律宾军队多次就对方声称拥有主权的多个浅滩和岛礁发生冲突。马尼拉为对抗中国军队而进行的新生现代化努力得到了美国和日本越来越多的支持。总部位于佛罗里达州的海上无人机制造商 Maritime Tactical Systems, Inc. 很早就被任命为菲律宾海军提供第一批无人水面航行器。目前，海军第一支无人水面航行器的核心由一艘 T38 Devil Ray 和四艘 MANTIS T12 组成。海军陆战队无人水面艇被转移到 MARTAC 的新苏比克湾设施。
根据该公司发布的消息，该无人机卓越中心旨在培训菲律宾无人机操作员并为“魔鬼鱼”储备零部件。MARTAC 发布的消息称：“该中心还将为当地创造就业机会和建立合作伙伴关系，以增强菲律宾在未来几年部署大型 USV 舰队的能力。”今年夏天，总部位于密西西比州的自主 USV 公司 Ocean Aero, Inc. 向菲律宾海军交付了四架 Triton 无人机。美国-菲律宾倡议目前的重点是提供海域意识能力，以解决东南亚群岛周围的重大差距

A MARTAC Devil Ray T38 unmanned surface vessel. MARTAC photo The Philippine Marine Corps received two American-made unmanned surface vessels last week at Subic Bay as part of Washington’s efforts to bolster Manila’s asymmetric capabilities in the South China Sea and Luzon Strait. On Nov. 4, two Maritime Tactical Systems T38 Devil Ray USVs were transferred to the Philippine Marine Corps at Subic Bay. “Today marks another meaningful step in our continuing effort to strengthen the capabilities of the Philippine Marine Corps, particularly in the field of archipelagic coastal defense,” said PMC Deputy Commandant Brig. Gen. Bayani Curaming at the ceremony, according to a transcript provided to USNI News. The Philippine Marine Corps was slated as the next force to receive drones after the Philippine Navy, USNI News reported in June . Manila’s Marines are at the forefront of South China Sea disputes, manning outposts surrounded by swarms of Chinese regular and paramilitary forces. An American defense official familiar with the matter also highlighted the possibility of the Philippine Army receiving drones through the program. The force is looking to expand its capabilities to monitor and hold targets under threat in its Archipelagic Coastal Defense plan, USNI News understands. In recent years, Philippine Marines have been equipped with BrahMos coastal defense cruise missiles and were relocated to strategic sealines of communication from the Sulu Sea to the Luzon Strait. Charlie Brown, the Director of the Yokosuka Council on Asia Pacific Studies’ Southeast Asia Regional Program, told USNI News that the drone transfer enables the Marines in maintaining awareness “across a large and increasingly contested maritime domain.” “This is an important element of building a credible archipelagic defense capability: not necessarily matching an adversary platform for platform, but using technology, information-sharing and distributed capabilities to make the Philippines’ maritime approaches more transparent and its territorial defense more resilient,” said Brown. These drones are under a broader effort from the Pentagon to enhance Philippine maritime domain awareness following a renewed series of tensions over disputed territories in the South China Sea between Manila and Beijing. Since 2023, Chinese and Philippine forces have repeatedly clashed across several shoals and reefs claimed by the other. Manila’s nascent modernization efforts to contend with Chinese forces has seen increased American and Japanese backing . Florida-based sea drone manufacturer Maritime Tactical Systems, Inc. was tapped early on to provide the Philippine Navy’s first USVs. Currently, the core of the sea service’s USV Unit One is composed of one T38 Devil Ray and four MANTIS T12s. The Marine Corps USVs were transferred at MARTAC’s new Subic Bay facility. According to a company release, the drone center of excellence is designed to train Philippine drone operators and stock parts for the Devil Rays. “The CoE will also enable creation of local jobs and partnerships to build Philippines capabilities for deploying a large USV fleet over the next several years,” reads the MARTAC release. Over the summer, Mississippi-based Autonomous USV firm Ocean Aero, Inc. delivered four Triton drones to the Philippine Navy. The U.S.-Philippine initiative is currently focused on delivering maritime domain awareness capabilities to address significant gaps around the Southeast Asian archipelago of more than 7,600 islands. However, the program plans to integrate one-way attack drones and other lethal capabilities by 2027.

summary: AIT 与 TECRO 通过新台湾奖学金计划加强美台伙伴关系 PR-2631 2026 年 11 月 11 日 AIT 与 TECRO 通过新台湾奖学金计划加强美台伙伴关系 2026 年 11 月 10 日，美国在台协会 (AIT) 华盛顿常务董事 Ingrid Larson 与台北驻美国经济文化代表处 (TECRO) 代表 Alexander Tah-Ray Yui 签署了一份建立台湾奖学金计划（TFP）的谅解备忘录（MOU）。 《台湾联谊法》获得国会通过并签署成为法律
content:
AIT 和 TECRO 通过新的台湾奖学金计划加强美国与台湾的伙伴关系 PR-2631 2026 年 11 月 11 日 AIT 和 TECRO 通过新的台湾奖学金计划加强美国与台湾的伙伴关系 2026 年 11 月 10 日，美国在台协会 (AIT) 华盛顿董事总经理 Ingrid Larson 和台北驻美国经济文化代表处 (TECRO) 代表 Alexander Tah-Ray Yui 签署了一份建立台湾奖学金计划（TFP）的谅解备忘录（MOU）。 《台湾奖学金法案》在两党广泛支持下获得国会通过并签署成为法律。今天，AIT 和 TECRO 签署了谅解备忘录，并与国务院教育和文化事务局协调，启动了该计划的实施。该计划的主要目标是扩大和加强美台伙伴关系，并加强美国官员在台湾和海峡两岸问题上的专业知识。 TFP 将在台湾各地建立一批具有语言技能、文化知识和持久工作关系的联邦专业人士。根据该奖学金计划，美国联邦雇员将花费长达一年的时间进行强化普通话培训和地区研究。培训完成后，研究员预计将在台湾议会办公室、部委、其他机构或办公室或台湾公共部门以外的组织工作最长一年。
国会议员以及美国国务院、TECRO 和 AIT 的代表出席了在弗吉尼亚州阿灵顿举行的签字仪式，与会者称赞该计划在加强美台伙伴关系和建立美国政府在台湾问题上的专业知识方面所发挥的作用。美国在台协会董事总经理英格丽·拉尔森 (Ingrid Larson) 表示：“TFP 反映了两党对美台关系的大力支持以及对以民间关系为核心的共同承诺。” 《AIT 和 TECRO 通过新台湾奖学金计划加强美台伙伴关系》一文首先发表在美国在台协会上。

【原文 English Original】
AIT and TECRO Strengthen U.S.-Taiwan Partnership Through New Taiwan Fellowship Program PR-2631 November 11, 2026 AIT and TECRO Strengthen U.S.-Taiwan Partnership Through New Taiwan Fellowship Program   On November 10, 2026, American Institute in Taiwan (AIT) Washington Managing Director Ingrid Larson and the Taipei Economic and Cultural Representative Office in the United States (TECRO) Representative Alexander Tah-Ray Yui signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) to establish the Taiwan Fellowship Program (TFP).   The Taiwan Fellowship Act was passed by Congress and signed into law with broad bipartisan support. Today’s signing of the MOU between AIT and TECRO initiates the program’s implementation, in coordination with the Department of State’s Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs. The main objectives of the Program are to expand and strengthen the U.S.-Taiwan partnership, as well as strengthen U.S. officials’ expertise regarding Taiwan and cross-Strait issues. TFP will build a group of federal professionals with language skills, cultural knowledge, and lasting working relationships across Taiwan.   Under the fellowship program, U.S. federal employees will spend up to one year in intensive Mandarin language training and area studies. Upon completion of training, the Fellows are expected to work, for up to one year, in Taiwan parliamentary offices, ministries, other agencies or offices, or organizations outside the public sector in Taiwan.   Members of Congress and representatives from the U.S. Department of State, TECRO, and AIT attended the signing ceremony in Arlington, Virginia, where attendees praised the program’s role in strengthening the U.S.-Taiwan partnership and building U.S. government expertise on Taiwan.   “TFP reflects strong bipartisan support for the U.S.-Taiwan relationship and a shared commitment to the people-to-people ties at its core,” said AIT Managing Director Ingrid Larson. USNI 新闻图 这些是根据海军和公开数据，截至 2026 年 11 月 9 日，美国海军在世界各地部署的航母打击群和两栖战备群的大致位置。如果 CSG 或 ARG 正在进行分类操作，图表会反映主力舰的位置。 2026 年 10 月 11 日，在日本，航空水手长的大副飞行员 Tykwon Young（右）和航空水手长的大副飞行员 Saabirah Parker 在停泊在佐世保湾的美国级两栖攻击舰的黎波里号 (LHA-7) 的飞行甲板上涂上小白眼。美国海军照片 USS 的黎波里号 (LHA-7) 停泊在日本佐世保港口。 2026 年 11 月 5 日，在日本海，第 13 海军陆战队远征队第 2/4 营登陆队的一名海军陆战队员在黄蜂级两栖攻击舰马金岛号 (LHD-8) 上进行静态快速绳索训练。美国海军陆战队照片 据舰艇观察员称，美国海军陆战队照片两栖攻击舰马金岛号 (LHD-8) 于周六从日本横须贺出发。马金岛两栖准备大队包括马金岛、安克雷奇号航空母舰 (LPD-23)、约翰·P·穆萨号航空母舰 (LPD-26) 和已上船的第 13 海军陆战队远征部队，目前正在日本海执行任务。 2026 年 10 月 22 日，来自新墨西哥州阿尔伯克基的加勒比海船体维护技术员二等迈克尔·布卢瓦斯三世 (Michael Bloise III) 在加勒比海航行的自由级濒海战斗舰明尼阿波利斯-圣保罗号 (LCS-21) 上进行焊接操作。
美国海军照片 濒海战斗舰明尼阿波利斯-圣保罗号 (LCS-21) 正在加勒比海中部作业。自由级濒海战斗舰驻扎在佛罗里达州梅波特海军基地。在地中海，三级内政通信电工 Micah Lee 在与刘易斯和克拉克级干货船 USNS Medgar Evers (T-AKE-13) 登上阿利·伯克级导弹驱逐舰 USS 进行海上补给之前检查通信设备巴尔克利号（DDG-84）在地中海，2026 年 10 月 22 日。美国海军照片 在地中海执行任务的独立部署的导弹驱逐舰包括：奥斯卡·奥斯汀号航空母舰（DDG-79），母港为罗塔海军基地。 USS Bulkeley (DDG-84)，母港为罗塔海军基地。美国海军保罗·伊格纳修斯号 (DDG-117)，母港为罗塔海军基地。斯托特号 (DDG-55) 母港位于弗吉尼亚州诺福克海军基地。2026 年 10 月 6 日，美国海军水手在阿利·伯克级导弹驱逐舰奥斯卡·奥斯汀号 (DDG-79) 上的驾驶室里站岗，当时该舰正通过苏伊士运河。美国海军照片 有两艘导弹驱逐舰在红海执行任务： USS Jason Dunham (DDG-109)，母港为佛罗里达州梅波特海军基地。美国海军冈萨雷斯号 (DDG-66)，母港为弗吉尼亚州诺福克海军基地。2026 年 11 月 7 日，在阿拉伯海，乔治·华盛顿号航空母舰 (CVN-73) 与刘易斯和克拉克级干货和弹药舰沃利·施艾拉号 (T-AKE-8) 一起进行海上补给。

title: From Bollywood to Clippy: Nvidia scandal, Outlook glitch fuel meme storm
zh_title: 从宝莱坞到 Clippy：Nvidia 丑闻、Outlook 故障助长模因风暴
summary: 从宝莱坞到 Clippy：Nvidia 丑闻、Outlook 故障助长模因风暴The Straits Times From Bollywood to Clippy: Nvidia scandal, Outlook glitch fuel meme storm Sign up now: Get insights on Asia's fast-moving developments FILE PHOTO: Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang arrives for a meeting with the Senate Banking Committee on Capitol Hill in Washington, DC, US, December 3, 2025. content:
从宝莱坞到 Clippy：Nvidia 丑闻、Outlook 故障助长模因风暴海峡时报
从宝莱坞到 Clippy：Nvidia 丑闻、Outlook 故障助长模因风暴
立即注册：深入了解亚洲的快速发展
文件照片：Nvidia 创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋于 2025 年 12 月 3 日抵达美国华盛顿特区国会山参加参议院银行委员会会议。REUTERS/Evelyn Hockstein/文件照片
发表于 2026 年 11 月 14 日 03:04
更新于 2026 年 11 月 14 日 03:09
11 月 13 日 - 黄仁勋扮演宝莱坞日场偶像、《黑客帝国》中的角色，或者在平行宇宙版《上床的间谍》海报上穿上红色天鹅绒套装：这位 Nvidia 联合创始人的婚外情，包括与一名中国女商人的婚外情，本周在互联网上引起了轩然大波。
人工智能的风暴生成了视频和图像，其中许多剪辑可能是在英伟达图形芯片的帮助下制作的，这为科技行业最著名的首席执行官之一倒台、抹去了数千亿投资者价值并引发全球调查的丑闻提供了一些缓解。
在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普任命史蒂芬·米勒为办公厅主任（周一生效）后，黄的表情包与包括 Outlook 和 Teams 在内的微软服务中断超过 12 小时的一系列搞笑表情包争夺了聚光灯，并以最新的斯蒂芬·米勒吸血鬼表情包拉开了一周的序幕。
但 RaviKunvariyaX 在 X 上打趣道，围绕黄仁勋退出 Nvidia 的危机的幽默主导了许多社交媒体的动态，其中许多剪辑可能是使用 Nvidia 图形芯片制作的。
“詹森实际上是在为基础设施提供资金、销售硬件并收取收入，而互联网则使用他自己的技术来欺骗他，”该用户说。
一张广为流传的图片显示，身穿 Nvidia 衬衫的黄仁勋转身避开 OpenAI、谷歌 Gemini 和 DeepSeek 等人工智能模型的标志，然后指着一名贴有“中国模型”标签的女性，这是对围绕他辞职的指控的戏谑。
《X》上的一则讽刺作品将黄仁勋和黄爱丽的脸放在经典情景喜剧《三人行》的片头字幕上，该剧讲述了一个男人和两个女室友的故事。
其他内容包括一段由人工智能生成的视频，观看次数达数百万次，其中主角是美国总统唐纳德·特朗普，以及其他描述这家芯片巨头幕后表面上发生的事情的视频。本周大部分时间，Nvidia 都是 Reddit 和 X 等热门平台的热门话题之一。
包括 Outlook 和 Teams 在内的微软服务中断了超过 12 个小时，导致一些企业争先恐后地抢购传真机、电话和纸张，这为本周晚些时候的表情包工厂增添了新的素材。
X 用户 omgsidewalks 发帖称，“不着急。慢慢来……周五快乐。”一篇被广泛转发的帖子写道，署名是“每一位公司员工”。 X 帖子的观看次数超过 400 万次。
其他模因想象微软备受诟病的 90 年代虚拟助手“Clippy”的角色，要么导致或解释了这次中断。
微软的服务一直是一个重复的模因主题，包括在 2024 年因 CrowdStrike 更新错误引发全球 IT 中断、导致 Windows 机器崩溃之后。
“每年，微软都应该关闭 Outlook 一个下午，这样我们就可以出去和朋友一起玩了:)，”另一篇获得数千次浏览的 X 帖子中写道。路透社

From Bollywood to Clippy: Nvidia scandal, Outlook glitch fuel meme storm
Sign up now: Get insights on Asia's fast-moving developments
FILE PHOTO: Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang arrives for a meeting with the Senate Banking Committee on Capitol Hill in Washington, DC, US, December 3, 2025. REUTERS/Evelyn Hockstein/File Photo
Published Nov 14, 2026, 03:04 AM
Updated Nov 14, 2026, 03:09 AM
Nov 13 - Jensen Huang as a Bollywood matinee idol, as a character from "The Matrix" or donning a red velvet suit on a poster for an alternate-universe version of "The Spy Who Shagged Me": the Nvidia co-founder's extramarital affairs, including with a Chinese businesswoman, set the Internet afire this week.
The storm of AI generated video and images, many of the clips were likely made with the help of Nvidia graphics chips, provided some light relief to a scandal that toppled one of the tech industry's most prominent CEOs, wiping out hundreds of billions of investor value and triggering investigations worldwide.
The Huang memes competed for the spotlight with a raft of comedic takes on the more than 12-hour outage of Microsoft services including Outlook and Teams, topping off a week that kicked off with the latest Stephen Miller vampire memes after U.S. President Donald Trump named him as chief of staff, effective Monday.
But it was humor on the crisis surrounding Jensen Huang's exit from Nvidia that dominated many social media feeds, with many of the clips likely made using Nvidia graphics chips, RaviKunvariyaX quipped on X.
"Jensen is literally funding the infrastructure, selling the hardware, and collecting revenue while the internet uses his own technology to troll him," the user said.
One widely shared image showed Jensen Huang in an Nvidia shirt turning away from logos for AI models including OpenAI, Google's Gemini and DeepSeek, then pointing at a woman labeled "Chinese Model," a play on the allegations surrounding his resignation.
A satire on X placed Jensen Huang and Alice Huang's faces over those of actors in the opening credits of the classic sit-com "Three's Company," about a man with two female roommates.
Others included an AI-generated video with millions of views featuring US President Donald Trump, along others depicting what ostensibly happened behind the scenes at the chip giant. Nvidia was among the trending topics in popular platforms such as Reddit and X for most of this week.
A more than 12-hour outage of Microsoft services, including Outlook and Teams, that sent some business scrambling for fax machines, phones and paper added fresh fodder for the meme factories late in the week.
"No rush. Take your time ... Happy Friday," read one widely shared post, signed "Every corporate employee," X user omgsidewalks posted. The X post was viewed over 4 million times.
Other memes imagined a role for Microsoft's much maligned 'Clippy' 90s-era virtual helper either causing or explaining the outage.
Microsoft's services have been a repeat meme subject, including after a global IT outage in 2024 triggered by a faulty CrowdStrike update, that crashed Windows machines.
"every year, microsoft should turn off outlook for an afternoon so we can all go outside and play with out friends :)," read another X post with thousands of views. REUTERS
