title: Hong Kong lawmakers pass bill to streamline Northern Metropolis development
zh_title: 香港立法会通过法案简化北方都市发展
summary: 香港立法者已通过一项法案，以简化耗资数十亿美元的北方都市计划，一名官员表示，当局计划在明年第一季度实施便利措施。这张照片显示了将成为香港北部都会区的地区，背景是深圳的天际线。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。立法会周四三读通过了《北方都市发展法案》，这是一项专门立法，旨在简化规划和土地程序，并加快建设和工业运营。
content:
香港立法者已通过一项法案，以简化耗资数十亿美元的北方都市计划，一名官员表示，当局计划在明年第一季度实施便利措施。这张照片显示了将成为香港北部都会区的地区，背景是深圳的天际线。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。立法会周四通过了《北方都市发展法案》的三读，该法案旨在简化规划和土地程序，并加快这一庞大项目的建设和工业运营。该立法还将促进资本、货物和人员的跨境流动，因为当局寻求通过这个大型项目加深香港与中国大陆的融合。一旦颁布，非保护区重新划定开发的审批期将从九个月缩短至两个月，同时征地和城市规划程序也将得到简化。发展主管伯纳黛特·林恩(Bernadette Linn)周四表示，当局计划在一月份向立法会提交附属立法，并在第一季度推出具体措施。 “现阶段，我们并不寻求一项能够解决所有可能情况的包罗万象的立法，”林恩用粤语告诉立法会议员。
“随着北方都市发展的进展，将出台新的立法，并根据需要修改现有条例。”发展局局长 Bernadette Linn。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。这个大型项目于 2021 年宣布，计划将约 300 平方公里（约占香港面积的三分之一）改造成香港与深圳边境沿线的创新和技术中心。另请参阅：科技城到大学城：为什么香港北部大都会将重点从高科技转向高等教育周三，当局和香港铁路运营商港铁公司宣布，一条连接北部大都会与香港现有地铁网络的新线路将耗资约 862 亿港元，比最初的估计下降了四分之一以上。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong lawmakers have passed a bill to streamline the multi-billion-dollar Northern Metropolis plan, with an official saying that authorities aim to implement facilitatory measures in the first quarter of next year. This photo shows the area that will become Hong Kong’s Northern Metropolis, with Shenzhen’s skyline in the background. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The Legislative Council (LegCo) on Thursday passed the third reading of the Northern Metropolis Development Bill, dedicated legislation that would streamline planning and land procedures and expedite construction and industrial operations in the sprawling project. The legislation would also facilitate the cross-boundary flow of capital, goods and people, as authorities seek to deepen Hong Kong’s integration with mainland China through the mega-project. Once enacted, the approval period for rezoning non-conservation areas for development could be cut from nine months to two, while land resumption and urban planning procedures would be simplified. Development chief Bernadette Linn said on Thursday that authorities were aiming to table subsidiary legislation to LegCo in January and roll out concrete measures in the first quarter. “At this stage we do not seek an all-encompassing piece of legislation capable of addressing every possible scenario,” Linn told lawmakers in Cantonese. “As the Northern Metropolis development progresses, new legislation will be introduced and existing ordinances will be amended as necessary.” Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The mega-project, announced in 2021, is set to transform about 300 square kilometres – roughly a third of the city’s territory – into an innovation and technology hub alongside Hong Kong’s border with Shenzhen. See also: Technopole to University Towns: Why Hong Kong’s Northern Metropolis shifted focus from hi-tech to higher ed On Wednesday, authorities and the MTR Corporation, Hong Kong’s railway operator, announced that a new line linking the Northern Metropolis with the city’s existing metro network would cost about HK$86.2 billion – down more than a quarter from original estimates.

title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns in the wake of multiple affairs, Chinese spy allegations
zh_title: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋因多项事务和中国间谍指控而辞职
summary: 英伟达董事会今天确认黄仁勋已辞去公司首席执行官职务。在此消息发布之前，黄仁勋曾卷入两起婚外情，其中一桩与一名疑似中国情报人员的婚外情，另一桩与他的直接下属英伟达医疗保健副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔 (Kimberly Powell) 发生关系。董事会表示：“NVIDIA（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）董事会今天宣布，黄仁勋已辞去总裁、首席执行官和董事会成员的职务，立即生效。” “Colette Kress，现任执行副总裁兼首席财务官
content:
英伟达董事会今天确认黄仁勋已辞去公司首席执行官职务。在此消息发布之前，黄仁勋曾卷入两起婚外情，其中一桩与一名疑似中国情报人员的婚外情，另一桩与他的直接下属英伟达医疗保健副总裁金伯利·鲍威尔 (Kimberly Powell) 发生关系。董事会表示：“NVIDIA（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）董事会今天宣布，黄仁勋已辞去总裁、首席执行官和董事会成员的职务，立即生效。” “NVIDIA 现任执行副总裁兼首席财务官 Colette Kress 已同意担任临时首席执行官。Kress 将继续担任执行副总裁兼首席财务官，同时担任临时首席执行官，直至任命永久继任者。董事会正在开始寻找永久首席执行官，并将考虑内部和外部候选人。”最近几周，有报道称黄与 Megaspeed 高管 Alice Huang 关系过于熟悉，美国情报机构怀疑黄可能是中国情报人员。据报道，这家 AI GPU 巨头的首席执行官可能成为间谍阴谋的目标——Megaspeed 因参与向中国走私价值 20 亿美元的出口管制 AI GPU 而受到调查。
消息传出后，英伟达股价在早盘交易中暴跌逾 10%，目前上个月跌幅超过 23%。 周末，黄仁勋承认自己对妻子不忠，并在全公司范围内道歉。另外，鉴于黄仁勋在全球人工智能革命中的作用，英伟达董事会对有关黄仁勋的卷入可能涉及国家安全问题的报道发起了独立调查。 Colette Kress 自 2013 年 9 月起担任 Nvidia 执行副总裁兼首席财务官；在此之前，她在思科和微软等公司工作了 25 年。几天后，第二个爆炸性报道出现，声称黄仁勋还与他在公司的直接下属之一鲍威尔有恋情。有报道称，这件事在公司内部是众所周知的，两人甚至被拍到在 Nvidia GTC 的圣何塞酒店里亲热。据称，安全人员隔离了一名旁观者，该旁观者用摄像机拍摄了整个互动过程，并要求该人签署一份保密协议。 Nvidia 还宣布 Harvey C. Jones 将担任公司首任董事会主席；他此前曾担任新思科技 (Synopsys) 首席执行官兼执行董事长。

【原文 English Original】
Nvidia’s board of directors has confirmed today that Jensen Huang has resigned as the company's CEO. The news follows revelations that Huang had been involved in not one but two extramarital affairs, one with a suspected Chinese intelligence asset, and another with his direct report, Nvidia’s VP of health care, Kimberly Powell. "NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) Board of Directors announced today that Jensen Huang has resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board, effective immediately," the board stated. "Colette Kress, current Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of NVIDIA, has agreed to serve as Interim Chief Executive Officer. Kress will continue to serve as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer while serving as Interim Chief Executive Officer until a permanent successor has been named. The Board is initiating a search for a permanent Chief Executive Officer and will consider internal and external candidates." In recent weeks, stories have come to light alleging that Huang was involved in an overly familiar relationship with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, whom U.S. intelligence agencies suspect may be a Chinese intelligence asset. It was reported that the AI GPU giant’s CEO may have been the target of a spy plot — Megaspeed is under investigatio n for its involvement in the smuggling of $2 billion worth of export-controlled AI GPUs into China. Nvidia shares plunged more than 10 percent in early market trading following the news, and are now down more than 23% in the last month. Over the weekend, Jensen Huang admitted that he had been unfaithful to his wife and issued a company-wide apology. Separately, Nvidia’s Board of Directors launched an independent investigation into reports that Huang’s entanglement may be a matter of national security, given his role in the global AI revolution. Colette Kress has been Nvidia's Executive Vice President and CFO since September 2013; prior to that, she spent 25 years at Cisco and Microsoft, among others. Just a couple of days later, a second bombshell report emerged claiming that Jensen Huang was also romantically involved with Powell , one of his direct reports at the company. Reports indicate the affair was known within the company, and that the two were even filmed being affectionate in a San Jose hotel at Nvidia GTC. Security allegedly sequestered a bystander who filmed the interaction on camera and made the person an offer to sign a nondisclosure agreement. Nvidia also announced that Harvey C. Jones will serve as the company's first-ever Chair of the Board; he has previously served as CEO and Executive Chairman of Synopsys.

title: Hong Kong gov’t workers granted up to 12 hours of annual family care leave from January
zh_title: 香港政府工作人员从一月起可享受最多 12 小时的年度家庭护理假
summary: 根据一项旨在促进家庭友好型工作场所的新举措，香港政府雇员从 2027 年 1 月起可享受最多 12 小时的带薪年度家庭护理假。香港，一名看门人带着一个小男孩散步。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。公务员事务局在周三向立法会提交的一份文件中表示，所有政府雇员，包括公务员和非公务员，可从一月份开始放带薪假期照顾家庭事务，例如陪同家人去看医生、参加家长会等。
content:
根据一项旨在促进家庭友好型工作场所的新举措，香港政府雇员从 2027 年 1 月起可享受最多 12 小时的带薪年度家庭护理假。香港，一名看门人带着一个小男孩散步。照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。公务员事务局在周三向立法会提交的一份文件中表示，所有政府雇员，包括公务员和非公务员，可从一月份开始享受带薪假期处理家庭事务，例如陪同家人去看医生、到孩子学校参加家长会、处理家庭紧急情况等。该文件称，虽然员工每年最多可以享受 12 小时的假期，但每次可以申请 1 到 4 小时的假期，未休的假期不能结转到下一年。员工需要提交预先申请表，无需提供证明文件，这是该局提出的简化审批程序的措施。文件中写道：“如果审批机关对申请有任何合理怀疑，或发现任何滥用家庭护理假的迹象，他/她可以要求申请人出示证明文件，并接受各种形式的文件，例如医疗证明、出勤单、学校通知等。”前往中央政府合署上班的公务员。资料图片：香港政府一站通。
香港领导人李约翰在 9 月的 2026 年施政报告中提出了为所有政府雇员设立家庭看护假的计划，这是一系列促进生育措施的一部分，包括延长一次性婴儿奖金和增加儿童税收津贴。该局正在与员工协商之前敲定该计划的细节，预计该假期将于 1 月份生效。 2025年，政府引入了育儿假，允许有三岁以下孩子的符合条件的员工每年享受最多三天的带薪休假。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong government employees have been granted up to 12 hours of paid annual family care leave from January 2027 under a new initiative to promote family-friendly workplaces. A caretaker walks with a little boy in Hong Kong. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. The Civil Service Bureau said in a document submitted to the Legislative Council on Wednesday that all government employees, including civil servants and those appointed on non-civil service terms, could take paid leave to take care of family matters from January, such as accompanying their family members to medical appointments, attending parent-teacher meetings at their children’s school, and attending to household emergencies. While employees may take up to 12 hours of leave per year, they can apply for between one and four hours on each occasion, according to the document, which added that untaken leave could not be carried forward to the following year. Employees will need to submit an advance application form without requiring documentary proof, a measure proposed by the bureau to streamline approval procedures. “If the approving authority has any reasonable doubt about the application or sees any signs of abuse of family care leave, he/she may request the applicant to produce documentary proof, and accept various forms of documentation, such as medical certificate, attendance slip, school notice, etc.,” the document reads. Civil Servants going to work at the Central Government Offices. File photo: GovHK. The city’s leader John Lee laid out plans to establish family care leave for all government employees in his 2026 Policy Address in September – part of a series of measures to promote fertility, including the extension of one-off baby bonuses and increased child tax allowances. The bureau is finalising the details of the scheme ahead of staff consultations, with the leave expected to take effect in January. In 2025, the government introduced childcare leave, allowing eligible employees with children under the age of three to take up to three days of paid leave annually.

title: Mass smuggling of up to 1.5 million Nvidia AI GPUs could be the underlying cause of Jensen Huang's departure, analysts claim
zh_title: 分析师称，大规模走私多达 150 万块 Nvidia AI GPU 可能是黄仁勋离职的根本原因
summary: 领先的半导体研究公司 SemiAnalysis 认为，黄仁勋突然离开英伟达可能不仅是因为他个人婚外情被曝光，还因为先进人工智能加速器向中国广泛非法出口。在最新的时事通讯中，分析师估计，尽管美国实施出口管制，仍有超过 1.5 吉瓦 (GW) 的 Nvidia 受限硬件（相当于多达 150 万个 GPU）抵达该国。深入了解 TH Premium：台湾、贸易和关税（图片来源：tsmc）
content:
领先的半导体研究公司 SemiAnalysis 认为，黄仁勋突然离开英伟达可能不仅是因为他个人婚外情被曝光，还因为先进人工智能加速器向中国广泛非法出口。在最新的时事通讯中，分析师估计，尽管美国实施出口管制，仍有超过 1.5 吉瓦 (GW) 的 Nvidia 受限硬件（相当于多达 150 万个 GPU）抵达该国。深入了解 TH Premium：台湾、贸易和关税（图片来源：tsmc） 虽然美国在芯片制裁上反复无常，但中国正在建立自己的芯片供应市场 中国长达十年的半导体推动状况 华为 Ascend NPU 路线图审视了中国长鑫存储的目标，到 2030 年，第六座大型晶圆厂将占据 30% 的 DRAM 内存市场份额 中国最新一轮稀土出口管制解释 超过 1.5 GW 的 Nvidia 硬件受到管制根据 SemiAnalysis 追踪人工智能加速器生产和目的地的加速器模型，近年来美国的出口限制最终最终落到了中国。该估算不包括 Nvidia 专门开发的符合美国出口规则的处理器，例如 H20 或 H800。该公司还声称，美国商务部对未经授权的运输规模也得出了类似的结论。
然而，SemiAnalysis 并未透露非法运往中国的加速器的确切数量，也没有透露 Nvidia 各代产品之间的比例。所谓的转移规模尤其引人注目，因为现代人工智能加速器需要大量电力和基础设施。虽然该报告没有解释如何将加速器数量转换为功率数据，但该公司很可能使用封装级铭牌/额定功率乘以 GPU 数量。假设所有这些AI GPU都是额定功率高达700W的Nvidia H200 SXM，那么中国大约有214.2万个此类加速器，而如果所有这些处理器都是额定功率高达1,000W的B200 SXM，那么我们谈论的是150万个。对于混合部署，总数将落在这些数字之间，具体取决于 H200 和 B200 加速器的比例。为了将这些数字放在上下文中，xAI 的 Colossus One 拥有 220-230,000 个 Hopper H100 和 H200 GPU，而 Colossus 2 的目标是 120 万个 Blackwell B200 和 B300 GPU。也就是说，中国 1.5 GW 的受限 Nvidia 硬件代表着巨大的计算基础设施数量，与 xAI 现有的整个 Colossus 业务的规模相当甚​​至超过。虽然 SemiAnalysis 没有透露受限制的人工智能加速器到达中华人民共和国的所有案例，但它通过两起著名的涉嫌 GPU 走私案件支持了其评估。
第一个涉及 Supermicro 联合​​创始人 Wally Liaw、台湾销售主管 Steven Chang 和承包商 Willy Sun，他们于 2026 年 3 月被指控。根据起诉书，价值约 25 亿美元的服务器被出售给东南亚的一家公司，价值 5.1 亿美元的设备随后转移到中国并由阿里巴巴获得。检察官指控被告在审计期间使用替代服务器并转移识别标签来隐藏硬件的实际目的地。第二起案件涉及与台湾英伟达、青云、长电、飞虎和超微有关的九名个人。当局指责

【原文 English Original】
Leading semiconductor research firm SemiAnalysis believes that Jensen Huang's sudden departure from Nvidia may have been driven not only by revelations about his personal extramarital relationships, but also by widespread illicit exports of advanced AI accelerators to China. In its latest newsletter, analysts estimate that more than 1.5 gigawatts (GW) worth of restricted Nvidia hardware, which could be equivalent to up to 1.5 million GPUs, has reached the country despite U.S. export controls. Go deeper with TH Premium: Taiwan, trade, and tariffs (Image credit: tsmc) While the U.S. flip-flops on chip sanctions, China is building its own chip supply market The state of China's decade-long semiconductor push Huawei Ascend NPU roadmap examined China's CXMT targets 30% DRAM memory market share by 2030 with sixth mega-fab China's latest round of rare-earth export controls explained Over 1.5 GW of Nvidia hardware subject to U.S. export restrictions ultimately ended up in China in recent years, according to SemiAnalysis' Accelerator Model, which tracks AI accelerator production and destinations. The estimate excludes processors that Nvidia specifically developed to comply with U.S. export rules, such as the H20 or H800. The firm also claims that the U.S. Department of Commerce has reached a similar conclusion about the scale of unauthorized shipments. Yet, SemiAnalysis does not disclose the exact number of accelerators shipped to China illegally, or their split between Nvidia's product generations. The scale of the alleged diversions is particularly notable because modern AI accelerators require substantial power and infrastructure. While the report does not explain how it converts accelerator quantities into power figures, it is likely that the company uses package-level nameplate/rated power multiplied by the number of GPUs. Assuming that all of these AI GPUs were Nvidia H200 SXM rated for up to 700W, then China got around 2.142 million of such accelerators, while if all of these processors were B200 SXM rated for up to 1,000W, then we are talking about 1.5 million units. For a mixed deployment, the total would fall between these figures, depending on the proportion of H200 and B200 accelerators. To put these numbers into context, xAI's Colossus One had 220-230,000 Hopper H100 and H200 GPUs, whereas the Colossus 2 has a target of 1.2 million Blackwell B200 and B300 GPUs. That said, 1.5 GW of restricted Nvidia hardware in China represents an enormous amount of computing infrastructure, which is comparable, or even exceeds, the scale of xAI's entire existing Colossus operation. While SemiAnalysis did not reveal all the cases in which restricted AI accelerators reached the People's Republic of China, it supports its assessment with two well-known cases of alleged GPU smuggling. The first involves Supermicro co-founder Wally Liaw, Taiwan sales executive Steven Chang, and contractor Willy Sun, who were charged in March 2026. According to the indictment, approximately $2.5 billion worth of servers were sold to a company in Southeast Asia, with $510 million worth of equipment subsequently diverted to China and obtained by Alibaba . Prosecutors allege that the defendants used substitute servers and transferred identification labels to conceal the actual destinations of the hardware during audits. The second case involves nine individuals associated with Nvidia, Albatron, Chief Telecom, Flying Tiger, and Supermicro in Taiwan. The authorities accuse the group of arranging unauthorized exports of 130 Nvidia B300-based servers, 74 of which eventually reached China. The suspects used shell companies, forged documents, and declared Japan as the destination for servers that were actually bound for China, according to prosecutors. Taiwanese authorities discovered the operation during a drug smuggling investigation. Both cases are still before the courts. Amidst the ongoing fallout and reports into Jensen's Huang's extramarital affair with Alice Huang, an alleged Chinese intelligence asset who was an executive at Megaspeed, one report claims that Ms. Huang was personally responsible for facilitating the smuggling of $7.5 billion of Nvidia AI hardware into China , around 240,000 GPUs, mostly H100 and H200 models. The right timing? SemiAnalysis suggests that the scale of these violations may explain why Huang's personal conduct became a major issue at this very point in time. The company's analysts speculate that some members of the U.S. intelligence community sought to remove Jensen Huang because he opposed more aggressive restrictions on China's access to American AI hardware. However, the report provides no direct evidence that intelligence agencies influenced Nvidia's board or that Huang participated in unauthorized exports. The timing also coincides with congressional efforts to advance the Remote Access Security Act (RASA), which passed the House of Representatives on January 12. The legislation is meant to extend U.S. export-control authority to remote access to advanced AI hardware hosted outside China, including data centers in Europe and the Middle East. SemiAnalysis reports that Nvidia and Oracle have actively opposed the proposal. The analysts believe that Huang's departure essentially removes an influential opponent of stricter restrictions and accelerates efforts to block Chinese companies from accessing American AI hardware in the cloud. However, SemiAnalysis warns that truly all-inclusive restrictions could encourage Chinese developers to adopt domestic accelerators (something that Jensen Huang has consistently warned about), undermine international AI software collaboration, and ultimately weaken American high-tech companies. Continued Chinese access to American AI accelerators offers several advantages to the U.S. technology industry, according to SemiAnalysis. Firstly, it generates revenue for American companies such as AMD, Nvidia, and cloud service providers. Secondly, when Chinese companies rent GPU capacity from data centers outside China, U.S. authorities retain the ability to monitor their activities and potentially terminate access if necessary due to national security concerns. Thirdly, prolonged reliance on American hardware reduces incentives for Chinese developers to adopt domestic AI accelerators, which could eventually compete with AMD and Nvidia in international markets. Another important aspect is the contribution of Chinese developers to the global software ecosystem. On the one hand, Chinese laboratories have developed open-source technologies such as DeepEP, DeepGEMM, and MSA, which improve the efficiency of AI workloads on Nvidia hardware and benefit developers worldwide. In addition, American companies also depend on Chinese engineers, component suppliers, and manufacturers. Therefore, legal curbs that completely restrict Chinese developers' access to American AI accelerators could undermine international cooperation, reduce availability of open-source optimizations, and encourage Chinese companies to develop software specifically for domestic hardware. On the other hand, access to advanced AI accelerators from AMD or Nvidia enables Chinese laboratories to develop increasingly sophisticated AI models, which will rival leading-edge models developed in America and perhaps create national security risks. To that end, SemiAnalysis acknowledges the need to limit China's access to advanced AI accelerators from U.S.-based companies, as they could, among other things, be used to develop weapons of mass destruction or undermine American national security in different ways. Yet, SA analysts argue that restrictions should focus on the amount and capabilities of hardware available to Chinese entities rather than completely prohibit any access. SemiAnalysis seems to favor a system in which Chinese developers can rent computing capacity from trusted providers outside China under U.S. oversight. Such an approach could preserve American technological influence and commercial benefits and limit China's ability to acquire advanced AI infrastructure independently.

title: China Lifts The Veil On Its GJ-11 Mysterious Dragon Stealth UCAV
zh_title: 中国揭开GJ-11神秘龙隐形无人机的面纱
summary: 中国为我们提供了迄今为止最清晰的 GJ-11 隐形无人战斗机 (UCAV) 展示，新的官方镜头揭示了这款飞翼无人机以前未见过的细节，包括其内部武器舱、起落架、安装在机头的传感器以及独特的排气装置。与此同时，中国人民解放军空军 (PLAAF) 还声称，GJ-11 已经完成了首次实弹打击任务，取得了成功。这有点令人费解，因为无人战斗机已经进行了多年的测试架次，包括在前方
content:
中国为我们提供了迄今为止最清晰的 GJ-11 隐形无人战斗机 (UCAV) 展示，新的官方镜头揭示了这款飞翼无人机以前未见过的细节，包括其内部武器舱、起落架、安装在机头的传感器以及独特的排气装置。与此同时，中国人民解放军空军 (PLAAF) 还声称，GJ-11 已经完成了首次实弹打击任务，取得了成功。这有点令人费解，因为无人作战飞机多年来已经进行了多次测试，包括在前沿作战地点，而且在此之前几乎无法想象是否进行过实弹武器投送。也许这是在转换过程中丢失某些东西的情况，例如使用新的内部传感器或新型武器发射。跑道上 GJ-11 的正面视图。 PLA screencap 这段视频昨天由中国国家电视台中央电视台播出，距离中国人民解放军空军成立 77 周年还有两天。随附的报告提供了有关该飞机预期任务集的更多详细信息，包括空袭和压制敌方防空系统（SEAD），以及它与有人战斗机的有人与无人编队（MUM-T）行动的整合。
新披露的信息让公众对 GJ-11 的配置有了最全面的了解，并进一步了解中国打算如何使用这款名为“玄龙”的隐形飞翼飞机。GJ-11 起飞。 PLA screencap 仔细观察 GJ-11 最暴露的视图之一显示了 GJ-11 的底面，清楚地暴露了其两个内部武器舱。腹侧舱位于飞机的混合翼体内，具有独立的门组，具有独特的锯齿状边缘——这是低可观察性飞机的常见特征。舱室的内部布局和尺寸仍不清楚，飞机可容纳的武器的精确范围也不清楚。然而，每个舱室似乎可以容纳至少 1,000 磅级武器，甚至可能容纳 2,000 磅级武器。 #GTMilitaryWatch 央视新闻军事频道周一发布了新镜头，以多角度特写镜头展示了中国人民解放军 (PLA) 空军的 GJ-11 隐形无人机。它还透露，空军首批自行训练的两架女无人机… pic.twitter.com/PPVmws9DJJ —《环球时报》（@globaltimesnews）2026年11月9日 据央视报道，这两个舱可携带多种空对地/水面弹药。
此前，中国航空工业集团公司 (AVIC) 在 2021 年中国航展上展示的 GJ-11 模型中曾透露过武器舱配置，但新的镜头可以更好地展示实际飞机。机库中 GJ-11 的正面视图，武器舱门部分打开。 PLA screencap 内部武器架是 GJ-11 隐蔽性设计的核心，使其能够携带弹药，而不会受到与外部挂架和挂具相关的雷达信号（和空气动力学）影响。此前于 2025 年 11 月发布的视频显示，GJ-11 正在飞行，起落架仍处于伸出状态。然而，其中一个新序列显示飞机起飞，随后的侧视图和后视图捕捉到了其起落架在升空后收回的情况。起落架本身非常坚固，包括一个重型起落架

【原文 English Original】
China has provided us with the clearest look yet at its GJ-11 stealth uncrewed combat aerial vehicle (UCAV), with new official footage revealing previously unseen details of the flying-wing drone, including its internal weapons bays, landing gear, nose-mounted sensor installation, and distinctive exhaust arrangement. The release also comes alongside a claim from the People’s Liberation Army Air Force (PLAAF) that the GJ-11 has completed its first live-fire strike mission, scoring a hit. This is somewhat puzzling, since the UCAV has racked up test sorties for years already, including at forward operating locations, and it seems almost inconceivable that a live weapons delivery would not have been conducted before now. Perhaps this is a case of something being lost in translation, such as the use of a new internal sensor or a new type of weapon delivery. Head-on view of a GJ-11 on the runway. PLA screencap The footage, broadcast by Chinese state television’s CCTV yesterday, comes two days ahead of the 77th anniversary of the founding of the PLAAF. Accompanying reporting provides additional details about the aircraft’s intended mission set, including airstrikes and suppression of enemy air defenses (SEAD), as well as its integration into manned-unmanned teaming (MUM-T) operations with crewed fighters. The new disclosures offer the most comprehensive public look yet at the GJ-11’s configuration and provide further insight into how China intends to employ the stealthy flying-wing aircraft, which is named Xuanlong — Chinese for Mystery Dragon. A GJ-11 takes off. PLA screencap A closer look at the GJ-11 One of the most revealing views shows the underside of the GJ-11, clearly exposing its two internal weapons bays. Located within the aircraft’s blended wing-body, the ventral bays have separate sets of doors with distinctive serrated edges — a common feature on low-observable aircraft. The internal arrangement and dimensions of the bays remain unclear, as does the precise range of weapons the aircraft can accommodate. However, it would appear likely that each bay can accommodate at least a 1,000-pound-class and likely a 2,000-pound-class weapon. #GTMilitaryWatch CCTV News military channel released new footage on Monday offering a close-up, multi-angle look at the Chinese People's Liberation Army (PLA) Air Force's GJ-11 stealth drone. It also revealed that two of the Air Force's first batch of self-trained female drone… pic.twitter.com/PPVmws9DJJ — Global Times (@globaltimesnews) November 9, 2026 According to CCTV , the two bays can carry a variety of air-to-ground/surface munitions. The weapons bay configuration had previously been revealed in a model of the GJ-11 displayed by the Aviation Industry Corporation of China (AVIC) at Airshow China in 2021, but the new footage provides a much better look at the actual aircraft. Head-on view of a GJ-11 in the hangar, with the weapons bay doors partially open. PLA screencap Internal weapons carriage is central to the GJ-11’s low-observable design, allowing it to carry munitions without the radar signature (and aerodynamic) penalties associated with external pylons and stores. Previous footage released in November 2025 showed the GJ-11 in flight with its landing gear remaining extended. However, one of the new sequences shows the aircraft taking off, with subsequent side and rear views capturing its landing gear retracting after liftoff. The landing gear itself is notably robust, including a heavy-duty twin-wheel nose unit. With that in mind, it may be the same landing gear as used in the GJ-21, a naval variant capable of operating from aircraft carriers and big-deck assault ships. A GJ-11 retracts its landing gear on takeoff. PLA screencap The new imagery also offers a closer look at a trapezoidal glazed fairing beneath the nose. This appears consistent with an electro-optical/infrared (EO/IR) sensor installation. Its precise configuration and capabilities have not been disclosed, but it’s worth noting that similar-looking installations also appear on the crewed J-20 and J-35 fighters, with these systems apparently being analogous to the electro-optical targeting system, or EOTS, found on the F-35 . If the sensor on the GJ-11 works like an EOTS, it would provide the drone with precision targeting and identification, lasing, as well as a secondary infrared search-and-track emulation function. A view of a GJ-11 showing the undernose EO/IR sensor installation. PLA screencap Perhaps the most distinctive external feature remains the GJ-11’s exhaust arrangement, for what is reported to be a WS-13 turbofan engine. A close-up of the rear of the aircraft shows the flattened exhaust outlet, shielded and integrated into the upper rear portion of the flying-wing airframe. Combined with the dorsal air intake and the absence of conventional exposed engine nozzles, this configuration is intended to reduce the aircraft’s radar and infrared signatures, especially from the most critical view aspects. The GJ-11’s tailless, blended-wing configuration is by now a defining feature of low-observable UCAV designs. Close-up of the tail section of a GJ-11. PLA screencap At least some of the GJ-11s shown have an air data boom on the nose. While normally associated with early flight testing, the GJ-11 is now far beyond that. The booms could still be fitted for some envelope expansion and other flight test work, although it may also simply involve earlier footage. Airstrikes and suppression of enemy air defenses Beyond the new imagery, one of the more interesting aspects of the CCTV coverage is its description of the GJ-11’s intended operational role. The broadcaster identified airstrikes and SEAD among the aircraft’s mission sets. The latter is particularly significant, as penetrating or operating within heavily defended airspace to locate and suppress or destroy enemy air defense systems is the most dangerous mission for a crewed combat aircraft. A stealthy uncrewed aircraft could contribute to these operations by carrying precision-guided weapons into more contested areas, providing additional sensing and targeting capacity, or forcing an adversary to expend valuable air defense resources. The two internal weapons bays provide the means to carry air-to-surface munitions while retaining the aircraft’s low-observable configuration. However, we don’t know which specific weapons have been integrated, their quantities, or whether the GJ-11 can employ dedicated anti-radiation weapons for SEAD missions. Alternative SEAD/DEAD loads could include multiple Small Diameter Bomb (SDB) equivalents, including those that are networked, as we have seen in previous concept videos . Many other types of standoff weapons could also be carried, with the platform itself using onboard sensors for fixing the target or acquiring targeting information from other sources via a tactical data network. Overhead view of a GJ-11 outside the hangar. PLA screencap First live-fire strike claim According to CCTV , the GJ-11 has completed its first live-fire strike mission, with two members of the PLAAF’s initial batch of female drone operators participating in the operation. One of the operators, Shi Xiaoran, described encountering cloud cover that initially obscured the target. After circling once more, she located it and released the weapon, scoring a hit. A drone controller flies a GJ-11 from a command-and-control trailer. PLA screencap One aspect that remains unclear is the extent to which the aircraft can independently identify and engage targets. A successful strike would demonstrate weapons employment, but not necessarily autonomous targeting or engagement. A view of a GJ-11 showing its triangular engine intake and undernose sensor installation. PLA screencap Manned-unmanned teaming with J-16 and J-20 fighters Perhaps the most strategically important aspect of the new coverage is its emphasis on manned-unmanned teaming. The CCTV footage showed mission planning involving a GJ-11 operating alongside J-16 Flanker multirole fighters and, in a separate sequence, J-20 fifth-generation stealth fighters. This provides a more explicit indication of the role China envisions for the GJ-11 within its broader combat aviation ecosystem. The J-16 provides a powerful multirole platform for strike and electronic warfare-related missions , while the J-20 offers a stealthy crewed counterpart for operations in highly contested airspace. An uncrewed aircraft operating alongside either type could extend the formation’s sensor coverage, carry additional weapons, conduct reconnaissance, or undertake particularly hazardous missions. A J-16D electronic warfare aircraft. via Chinese internet As a loyal wingman, the GJ-11’s role would extend beyond simply carrying weapons, with the UCAV able to act as an additional airborne sensor and strike platform, allowing crewed aircraft to distribute tasks across a larger formation. At the same time, the footage does not establish how the UCAVs communicate with their crewed counterparts, how targeting information is shared, or the level of autonomy available to the GJ-11. The new footage shows the drone being flown under man-in-the-loop (MITL) direct control, but it likely features, or will feature, semi-autonomous control modes, especially for teaming applications, which will require a high degree of onboard autonomy. We do know that China expects the UCAV to be controlled by crewed aircraft, as part of its basic concept. The PLAAF has at least trialed crewed aircraft as drone controllers , and this is one mission set that has frequently been ascribed to the two-seat J-20S . A stock photo of the two-seat J-20S. via X From prototype to operational platform After years of development involving the experimental Sharp Sword design , the much more evolved GJ-11 platform was publicly unveiled during China’s National Day military parade in Beijing in October 2019. Its development is associated with Hongdu Aviation Industry Group, part of the broader AVIC aviation-industrial structure. Two views of an early Sharp Sword UCAV demonstrator. via X A model displayed by AVIC at Airshow China in 2021 provided an early indication of the aircraft’s internal weapons-carrying arrangement. In November 2025, as we reported at the time , the PLAAF released footage of the GJ-11 flying alongside a J-20 and a J-16D electronic warfare aircraft, suggesting that it may have entered service or was at least being integrated into the service’s broader air combat architecture. A screencap from an earlier video showing a GJ-11 flying alongside a J-16D and a J-20. PLA screencap Development and testing of the GJ-11 have been underway for years, with notable activity at China’s secretive Malan test facility in Xinjiang. Satellite imagery reviewed by TWZ has documented repeated, and at times near-daily, GJ-11 activity there, including multiple aircraft operating together. The deployment of three GJ-11s to Shigatse in Tibet between August and September 2025 provided an additional indication that the program was moving beyond test work toward operational evaluation. Two GJ-11s seen on the ramp at Malan on July 12, 2024. PHOTO © 2024 PLANET LABS INC. ALL RIGHTS RESERVED. REPRINTED BY PERMISSION Another image circulating on Chinese social media shows three additional GJ-11s parked alongside another example of the same type. Three GJ-11s in a hangar. PLA screencap Another hangar view with likely a fourth GJ-11 just visible on the right. PLA screencap According to Andreas Rupprecht, an expert on Chinese aviation and contributor to TWZ , numbers that can be seen on the drones themselves likely point to these aircraft being low-rate initial production (LRIP) examples. And what’s even more interesting is that, for the first time, numbers are clearly visible which – and I’m going to go out on a limb here – I believe are not serial numbers but rather design numbers. The numbers 0003, 0011 and 0012 are visible, so these are probably LRIP aircraft. pic.twitter.com/zH2D2Narr9 — @Rupprecht_A (@RupprechtDeino) November 10, 2026 The new releases come less than a month after China announced that the GJ-21 naval derivative had completed its first launch and recovery aboard the new Type 076 amphibious assault ship Sichuan , which is equipped with an electromagnetic catapult and arresting gear. The milestone would pave the way for the PLA Navy to field a shipborne stealth UCAV for strike and reconnaissance missions. However, China has yet to release actual footage of the claimed operation, leaving it independently unverified. The Type 076 amphibious assault ship Sichuan seen leaving Hudong-Zhonghua Shipyard for its first sea trials. Government of the People’s Republic of China The broader significance of the GJ-11 lies in the fact that it’s a genuine UCAV, not simply a loyal wingman designed to accompany a crewed fighter . Free of the endurance limitations imposed by a human crew, a platform of this class could likely offer at least twice the combat radius of a comparable crewed fighter. More importantly, it is intended to have the autonomy to conduct tactical missions independently, as well as operate alongside crewed aircraft. That opens up the possibility of extending China’s strike and reconnaissance reach considerably beyond what its existing low-observable crewed combat aircraft can achieve. The GJ-11’s flying-wing configuration, internal weapons bays, and emphasis on signature reduction suggest a platform approaching the very-low-observable (VLO) category. At the same time, China is now openly fielding a capability that the United States has conspicuously failed to bring into public operational service. In the late 2000s and early 2010s, the United States appeared to be leading the way in stealth UCAV development, with programs such as the Boeing Phantom Ray , X-45 , and X-47B demonstrating the potential of autonomous, long-range penetrating aircraft. Yet those ambitions effectively disappeared from the publicly acknowledged force-development agenda. The Pentagon has instead concentrated on lower-end and less capable Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA), generally designed to operate in conjunction with crewed fighters . Northrop Grumman’s X-47B UCAV demonstrator. U.S. Navy Northrop Grumman’s much larger X-47B that also featured a ‘cranked kite’ planform. USN As we argued in our earlier examinations of the American UCAV gap , the absence of a publicly acknowledged, sizeable force of independent, long-range stealth combat drones remains a significant weakness in U.S. airpower planning. Classified programs may exist, and the U.S. military certainly operates highly sophisticated stealthy uncrewed reconnaissance platforms , but even a small clandestine combat capability would be unlikely to make a decisive difference in a major, sustained conflict. China, meanwhile, is moving towards making this class of aircraft a central part of its military inventory. Important questions about the GJ-11 remain, particularly regarding its actual weapons load, various specifications, its degree of autonomy, and its ability to operate in coordination with crewed fighters. However, the latest official coverage provides the clearest indication yet of how China intends to employ its stealth UCAV in a future conflict, and sheds a little more light on the Mystery Dragon. Contact the author: thomas@thewarzone.com The post China Lifts The Veil On Its GJ-11 Mysterious Dragon Stealth UCAV appeared first on TWZ .

title: 多個團體法拉盛紀念孫中山誕辰160周年
summary: 多民主團體在法拉盛紀念孫中山誕辰160周年。（主辦方提供） 【大紀元2026年11月14日訊】（大紀元記者林丹紐約報導）中華民國海外公民委員會等多個團體11月12日在紐約法拉盛舉行集會，紀念中華民國國父孫中山先生誕辰160周年。參與者回顧孫中山創建中華民國的歷程，並呼籲傳承自由、平等、博愛精神，並關注中國大陸未來的民主轉型。 現場民眾拉起「隆重紀念孫中山先生誕辰160周年」橫幅，並擺放中華民國公民聯盟、中華民國國軍老兵關愛中心、中華民國海外公民委員會及中國新民黨等團體的展板。
content:
多民主團體在法拉盛紀念孫中山誕辰160周年。（主辦方提供）
【大紀元2026年11月14日訊】（大紀元記者林丹紐約報導）中華民國海外公民委員會等多個團體11月12日在紐約法拉盛舉行集會，紀念中華民國國父孫中山先生誕辰160周年。參與者回顧孫中山創建中華民國的歷程，並呼籲傳承自由、平等、博愛精神，並關注中國大陸未來的民主轉型。
現場民眾拉起「隆重紀念孫中山先生誕辰160周年」橫幅，並擺放中華民國公民聯盟、中華民國國軍老兵關愛中心、中華民國海外公民委員會及中國新民黨等團體的展板。
中華民國海外公民委員會執行長曹聖華宣讀的紀念文，以「革命尚未成功，同志仍需努力」勉勵參與者，表示紀念孫中山不僅是回顧歷史，也是在當前局勢下思考如何延續其追求民主與自由的理想。
他表示，台灣今日的民主發展，是對孫中山建國理念的傳承，也是紀念他最好的獻禮。
曹聖華指出，依據中華民國憲法、中華民國憲法增修條文，中華民國國籍法之規定，國家統一前，中華民國分為兩個部分：大陸地區（淪陷區）和台灣地區(自由區），兩區的國人都具有中華民國國籍。在世界其它地區的華人不論來自哪裡，都是中華民國的海外公民。
曹聖華指出：如今多災多難的大陸淪陷區來到了歷史的轉折點。竊取淪陷區治權的中共行將潰敗、解體，並且已經進入倒數計時。
活動亦將焦點放在中國大陸未來的政治走向。曹聖華提出，在中共統治結束後，中國大陸如何避免動盪、內鬥與分裂，實現和平轉型、走向民主自由，是各界需要共同思考的課題。
中華民國國軍老兵關愛中心董事長胡福慶、中國新民黨創始人楊茂森、中華民國國軍老兵關愛中心執行長王莉以及邱玥澐、宗海峰、孫帆等人參加了活動。

title: Trump says China bears ‘hatred’ for Hong Kong’s Jimmy Lai, casting doubt on his release
zh_title: 特朗普称中国对香港黎智英怀有“仇恨”，并对他的释放表示怀疑
summary: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周四表示，中国对香港民主派媒体大亨黎智英怀有“极大的仇恨”，不太可能释放他出狱。 2025 年 5 月 8 日，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在椭圆形办公室。照片：白宫，来自 Flickr。 78 岁的黎智英是现已不复存在的《苹果日报》创始人，2 月份在香港发生广泛的民主抗议活动后，因与外国勾结和煽动叛乱罪被判处 20 年监禁。人权组织和外国政府呼吁释放黎智英，特朗普在 5 月表示
content:
美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周四表示，中国对香港民主派媒体大亨黎智英怀有“极大的仇恨”，不太可能释放他出狱。 2025 年 5 月 8 日，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在椭圆形办公室。照片：白宫，来自 Flickr。 78 岁的黎智英是现已不复存在的《苹果日报》创始人，2 月份在香港发生广泛的民主抗议活动后，因与外国勾结和煽动叛乱罪被判处 20 年监禁。人权组织和外国政府呼吁释放黎智英，特朗普五月表示，他此前曾与习近平主席讨论过此案。 “那里存在很大程度的仇恨，”特朗普在接受塞勒姆新闻频道采访时表示。 “习主席解释了香港发生的事情……黎智英是（民主运动）的领导人，这给他们带来了巨大的痛苦，”这位美国总统说。黎智英，2020 年。照片：HKFP。特朗普将于下周在中国深圳举行的亚太经合组织会议上与习近平会面。但美国总统对黎智英的释放前景并不乐观。 “我已经让其他人离开了。黎智英的情况有点不同，”特朗普说。在特朗普五月向习近平提出此事后，北京释放了地下教会创始人金以斯拉 (Ezra Jin)。然而，特朗普五月表示，黎智英对习近平来说是“一个难缠的人”。

【原文 English Original】
US President Donald Trump said on Thursday that China harbours a “great level of hatred” towards Hong Kong’s pro-democracy media mogul Jimmy Lai and is unlikely to release him from jail. US President Donald Trump in the Oval Office on May 8, 2025. Photo: The White House, via Flickr. Lai, the 78-year-old founder of the now-defunct Apple Daily newspaper, was sentenced in February to 20 years in prison on charges of foreign collusion and sedition following widespread pro-democracy protests in Hong Kong. Rights groups and foreign governments have called for Lai’s release, and Trump said in May that he had previously discussed the case with President Xi Jinping. “There’s a great level of hatred there,” Trump told Salem News Channel in an interview. “President Xi explained what happened with Hong Kong and… that Jimmy Lai was the leader (of the pro-democracy movement), and it caused them tremendous distress,” the US president said. Jimmy Lai in 2020. Photo: HKFP. Trump is due to meet Xi next week at the APEC gathering in the Chinese city of Shenzhen. But the US president was not optimistic about the prospect of Lai’s release. “I’ve gotten others out. Jimmy Lai’s a little bit of a different story,” Trump said. Beijing freed the founder of an underground church, Ezra Jin, after Trump raised his case with Xi in May. However, Trump said in May that Jimmy Lai is “a tough one” for Xi.

【看中国2026年11月14日讯】（看中国记者尹华综合报道）美国海军研究生院能源学术组成员布伦达·沙弗（Brenda Shaffer）近日表示，加拿大拥有加强西方能源安全、创造巨额财富的资源条件，却在限制自身产能的同时，加深了对中国的依赖。 看中国网站 禁止建立鏡像網站。返回正版看中国网站。
沙弗近日在《The Bureau》播客中表达了自己的核心观点，即西方国家过于倾向把能源当作“气候美德”的表态，忽视了谁来生产能源、谁掌控输送设备、谁能切断供应这些战略后果。“加拿大不仅可以通过提高产量、建设基础设施为全球安全作出重大贡献，还能赚大钱。”她说。
在她看来，加拿大尤其容易受到中国影响、国际气候政治与国内能源开发阻力三重因素的叠加冲击。她认为，中国对加拿大的渗透“可能比大多数西方国家更深”。
节目中，沙弗从瑞典气候活动人士格蕾塔·通贝里转向亲巴勒斯坦的活动谈起，提出所谓“红绿绿联盟”概念：第一个“红”指激进左翼与中国，后两个“绿”分别指伊斯兰主义运动和气候组织。她主张，这些群体即便动机不同，也可能在削弱西方机构与战略利益的行动上形成合流。她同时明确表示，并不认为这些网络事先知晓2023年10月7日哈马斯袭击。
总理马克·卡尼是她批评的焦点之一。卡尼在出任总理前，曾于2021年发起“格拉斯哥净零金融联盟”，后来迈克尔·布隆伯格加入担任联席主席。沙弗认为，引导资金远离化石燃料的做法抑制了对世界仍然需要的能源供应的投资，一旦战争或其他冲击发生，各国将更易遭遇短缺和价格飙升。
不过她强调，保障能源安全并不意味着反对可再生能源。“我认为自己是‘燃料中立’的。”她说。她主张从一国的资源、气候、人口、经济和战略需求出发，选择最合适的能源组合；她反对的是在替代方案尚未就绪时，就以金融和监管手段让现有能源变得稀缺或昂贵。
她指出，中国可以利用以煤为主的电力系统制造可再生能源设备并出口，在西方供应链依赖加深的同时获取收入和影响力。针对谷歌前首席执行官埃里克·施密特关于中国可再生能源充沛的说法，她提醒应区分电力与一次能源总供应。据能源研究所2026年报告，2025年化石燃料约占全球一次能源供应的86%。
沙弗还点名电力逆变器等联网设备可能成为安全隐患，称受损的能源基础设施或能在敌方动用军舰战机之前就扰乱军事行动。“你不必在台湾附近击落飞机。”她说。她同样关注联网汽车和港口设备可能带来的监控、数据窃取与干扰风险。西方安全机构此前已指出，“伏特台风”旨在将黑客潜伏于美国关键基础设施，“盐台风”则渗透包括加拿大在内的全球电信网络。基于这些担忧，她反对加拿大向中国电动车开放市场。
她还认为，对数据中心等人工智能基础设施的抵制，可能成为西方又一项自我设限。
沙弗的药方只有一个字：建。扩大产量，完善输送基础设施，推动全球供应多元化，让更少国家依赖脆弱的海上咽喉要道。
她最后说，加拿大风景优美、民众教育程度高、资源禀赋出众。“你得非常努力，”她说，“才能让繁荣和安全不发生。”

• 根据中国外交部发布的声明，王毅在会见韩国外长赵贤时表示，两国是“搬不走的近邻”，“保持睦邻友好是双方的正确选择”

• 李明博于 2025 年 6 月上任，寻求恢复关系，于 2025 年底在庆州接待中国国家主席习近平，并于 1 月对中国进行国事访问
• 王毅表示，中方愿同韩方进一步增进互信，扩大共同利益
• 下周，韩国总统李在明将访华并出席在深圳举行的亚太经合组织（APEC）领导人会议 路透社

BEIJING, Nov 13 - China is willing to expand cooperation with South Korea in traditional and emerging sectors including artificial intelligence and biomedicine, Foreign Minister Wang Yi said on Friday.
• In a meeting with his South Korean counterpart Cho Hyun, Wang said the two countries are "close neighbours that cannot be moved away" and "maintaining good-neighbourliness and friendship is the right choice for both sides," according to a statement released by China's Foreign Ministry
• The South Korean diplomat is on a two-day visit to China starting Friday
• China-South Korea relations were "back onto the right track" after their leaders' exchanges since late last year, Wang said
• Ties soured under Yoon Suk Yeol, the predecessor of South Korean President Lee Jae Myung, who drew Seoul closer to Washington and Tokyo
• Lee, who took office in June 2025, has sought to restore relations, hosting Chinese President Xi Jinping in Gyeongju in late 2025 and making a state visit to China in January
• China is willing to further enhance mutual trust with South Korea and expand their common interests, Wang said
• Next week, South Korean President Lee Jae Myung will visit China and attend the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) leaders' meeting in Shenzhen REUTERS

title: Hong Kong to gazette bill barring those with national security convictions from teaching
zh_title: 香港将在宪报刊登法案，禁止有国家安全罪的人从事教学
summary: 香港政府宣布了一项将于本周五在宪报刊登的法律草案，禁止犯有国家安全罪的人在香港担任教师。 2024 年 8 月 8 日，香港历史博物馆的国家安全展览厅。照片：Hans Tse/HKFP。教育局在周四的一份声明中表示，《2026年教育（修订）条例草案》下的国家安全保障以及认证要求将“确保所有教师都是适当人选”。它表示将在周五公布该法案，“目的是加强
content:
香港政府宣布了一项将于本周五在宪报刊登的法律草案，禁止犯有国家安全罪的人在香港担任教师。 2024 年 8 月 8 日，香港历史博物馆的国家安全展览厅。照片：Hans Tse/HKFP。教育局在周四的一份声明中表示，《2026年教育（修订）条例草案》下的国家安全保障以及认证要求将“确保所有教师都是适当人选”。该机构表示，将于周五在宪报刊登该法案，“旨在通过实施执业证书要求来加强教师注册机制，并引入处理被判危害国家安全罪的人员的教师注册事宜的机制。”声明称，新制度将“提高社会对教育职业的认可，提高教师的社会地位”。该法案定于 11 月 25 日提交立法会（立法会）。国家安全审查 在北京于 2020 年 6 月在香港实施国家安全法几个月后，香港当局推出了以国家安全为重点的课程指南。当地学校的教师现在还必须通过香港小宪法和国家安全立法的测试，然后才能被任命。
根据该法案建立的认证制度将授予教师执业证书，有效期不超过三个学年，之后必须更新。另请参阅：Nat。学校活动现在需要外部组织者进行安全检查，以防止‘政治宣传’。声明称，“在社会复杂多变的发展背景下，公众和家长对教师专业精神的期望越来越高。”该法案符合学校的实际运营需要，鼓励教师与时俱进，加强教师管理，最终目的是保障学生的福祉。”

【原文 English Original】
The Hong Kong government has announced a draft law set to be gazetted this Friday barring people convicted of national security offences from becoming teachers in the city. The National Security Exhibition Gallery in the Museum of History in Hong Kong, on August 8, 2024. Photo: Hans Tse/HKFP. The Education Bureau said in a Thursday statement that the national security safeguard under the Education (Amendment) Bill 2026, along with a certification requirement, would “ensure that all teachers are fit and proper persons.” It said it would gazette the bill on Friday “with the aim of enhancing the teacher registration mechanism by imposing practising certificate requirements, and introducing a mechanism to handle matters of teacher registration for persons convicted of offences endangering national security.” The new system would “elevate society’s recognition of the education profession and raise the social status of teachers,” the statement said. The bill is set to be introduced to the Legislative Council (LegCo) on November 25. National security vetting Hong Kong authorities introduced national security-focused curriculum guidelines months after Beijing imposed a national security law in the city in June 2020. Teachers in local schools must now also pass a test on the city’s mini-constitution and its national security legislation before they can be appointed. The certification system established under the bill will grant teachers a practising certificate valid for no more than three school years, after which it must be renewed. See also: Nat. security checks now required for school activities by external organisers to prevent ‘political propaganda’ “Amid the complex and rapidly changing development of our society, the public and parents have increasingly high expectations of teachers’ professionalism,” the statement said. “The bill meets schools’ actual operational needs, encourages teachers to keep pace with the times and strengthens teacher management, with the ultimate goal of safeguarding the well-being of students,” it continued.

title: Joint Statement on U.S.-Japan Seabed Mineral Resource Development
zh_title: 美日海底矿产资源开发联合声明
summary: 发言人办公室关于美日海底矿产资源开发的联合声明 媒体报道 2026 年 11 月 12 日 以下声明的文本由美利坚合众国和日本政府在美国负责海底矿产开发的跨部门代表团访问日本之际发布。开始文本。美国和日本政府重申，经济安全合作是美日联盟不可或缺的一部分，安全、有弹性和多样化的关键矿产供应链对于繁荣至关重要
content:
发言人办公室关于美日海底矿产资源开发的联合声明 媒体报道 2026 年 11 月 12 日 以下声明的文本由美利坚合众国和日本政府在美国负责海底矿产开发的跨部门代表团访问日本之际发布。开始文本。美国和日本政府重申，经济安全合作是美日联盟不可或缺的一部分，安全、有弹性和多样化的关键矿产供应链对两国的繁荣和国家安全至关重要。两国政府认识到负责任的海底矿产资源开发的潜力，可以使关键矿产供应多样化、创造新的商业机会并支持两国的工业基础。这项合作建立在特朗普总统和高市首相于 2025 年 10 月签署的《美日通过采矿和加工确保关键矿产和稀土供应的框架》中规定的共同目标的基础上，并通过美日双边举措得到推进，其中包括美国商务部与日本经济产业省于 2026 年 3 月签署的合作备忘录 (MoC)。
两国政府对谅解备忘录所取得的进展表示欢迎，包括 11 月 11 日至 12 日在日本富山举行的美日工作组第二次会议，会议讨论了日本南鸟岛附近的稀土泥浆项目及其多金属结核项目，以及扩大了政府官员、行业利益相关者、研究人员和技术专家之间的接触。展望未来，美国和日本政府计划推进以下优先事项： 深化与美国和日本的接触行业利益相关者并在整个海底矿物供应链中建立值得信赖的商业伙伴关系；确保值得信赖的合作伙伴之间的处理能力，以减少供应链漏洞；保护敏感技术和专有信息；交流与深海勘探、海底测绘和资源表征、环境评估、缓解和监测、技术创新和资源开发相关的先进技术和方法的信息和最佳实践；探索促进科学理解的机会，例如协调船只、自主水下航行器和其他相关资产的访问和使用，以支持联合研究、技术演示和各自的美国项目。
和日本海底勘探活动；根据国家法律和政策，促进与最佳实践相关的监管交流，包括缓解和监测、技术进步、环境评估、数据管理和适应性管理；促进明确、精简和可预测的监管方法，促进海底矿物部门的私人投资；促进国内和国际监管制度之间的互补性，以支持商业可行性和行业的长期确定性；寻求更多伙伴关系，推进负责任的海底矿产资源开发。两国政府重申致力于政府整体协调和务实合作，调动两国互补的科学、技术、产业力量

【原文 English Original】
Office of the Spokesman Joint Statement on U.S.-Japan Seabed Mineral Resource Development Media Note November 12, 2026 The text of the following statement was released by the Governments of the United States of America and Japan on the occasion of a visit to Japan by a U.S. interagency delegation focused on seabed minerals development. Begin Text. The Governments of the United States and Japan reaffirm that economic security cooperation is an indispensable part of the U.S.-Japan Alliance and that secure, resilient, and diversified critical mineral supply chains are essential to the prosperity and national security of both countries. The two governments recognize the potential for responsible seabed mineral resource development to diversify critical mineral supplies, create new commercial opportunities, and support the two countries’ industrial bases. This cooperation builds on the shared objectives set out in the United States-Japan Framework for Securing the Supply of Critical Minerals and Rare Earths through Mining and Processing, signed by President Trump and Prime Minister Takaichi in October 2025, and is being advanced through U.S.-Japan bilateral initiatives, including the Memorandum of Cooperation (MoC) between the U.S. Department of Commerce and the Japanese Ministry of Economy, Trade, and Industry signed in March 2026. The two governments welcomed progress under the MoC, including the second meeting of the U.S.-Japan Working Group on November 11 and 12 in Toyama, Japan, which included discussions on Japan’s rare-earth mud project near Minamitorishima Island and its polymetallic nodules project, as well as expanded engagement among government officials, industry stakeholders, researchers, and technical experts. Looking ahead, the Governments of the United States and Japan plan to advance the following priorities: Deepen engagement with U.S. and Japanese industry stakeholders and foster trusted commercial partnerships across the full seabed mineral supply chain; Secure processing capacity among trusted partners to reduce supply chain vulnerabilities; Safeguard sensitive technologies and proprietary information; Exchange information and best practices on advanced technologies and methodologies related to deep-sea exploration, seabed mapping and resource characterization, environmental assessment, mitigation and monitoring, technological innovation, and resource development; Explore opportunities to advance scientific understanding such as coordinating access to, and use of, vessels, autonomous underwater vehicles, and other relevant assets in support of joint research, technology demonstrations, and respective U.S. and Japanese seabed exploration campaigns; Facilitate regulatory exchanges related to best practices, including for mitigation and monitoring, technological advancements, environmental assessments, data management, and adaptive management, consistent with national laws and policies; Promote clear, streamlined, and predictable regulatory approaches that facilitate private investment in the seabed minerals sector; Promote complementarity between domestic and international regulatory regimes to support commercial viability and long-term certainty for industry; and Seek additional partnerships to advance responsible seabed mineral resource development. The two governments reaffirm their commitment to whole-of-government coordination and practical cooperation that mobilizes their complementary scientific, technological, industrial, diplomatic, and financial strengths. They intend to support commercial opportunities, encourage private-sector investment, and foster trusted partnerships across mineral supply chains to accelerate responsible seabed mineral resource development, strengthen critical mineral security, and advance the shared economic security of the United States and Japan. End Text.

title: ‘Broken and shattered’ Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang surrendered during resignation meeting, report claims
zh_title: 报道称，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在辞职会议上“心碎”
summary: 据报道，英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋在离开这家他创建了 33 年的公司时称自己为“一坨狗屎”。据彭博社报道，这位以其传奇般的精力和性格外向的举止而闻名的联合创始人在董事会会议上投降了，看上去“心碎又破碎”。在承认至少一次婚外情（其中包括与一名疑似中国间谍的婚外情）后，他从这家人工智能硬件公司辞职。但尽管他辞职并引发了围绕他的争议，英伟达员工似乎仍在支持他，该网站上有数千条评论。
content:
据报道，英伟达前首席执行官黄仁勋在离开这家他创建了 33 年的公司时称自己为“一坨狗屎”。据彭博社报道，这位以其传奇般的精力和性格外向的举止而闻名的联合创始人在董事会会议上投降了，看上去“心碎又破碎”。在承认至少一次婚外情（其中包括与一名疑似中国间谍的婚外情）后，他从这家人工智能硬件公司辞职。据《连线》报道，尽管他辞职并引发了争议，但英伟达员工似乎仍在支持他，公司内部“意见箱”上有数千条评论，显示了对这位名誉扫地的领导人的支持。 “如果你相信使命，那就把老板带回来，”一位评论者说，而另一位评论者则写道，“我们都是人类，都会犯错误。詹森做了很多好事，他需要第二次机会。”一名英伟达员工私下告诉《连线》杂志，“英伟达因詹森而成为英伟达”，尽管另一名员工向全公司范围内发送了一封电子邮件，要求他的辞职透明化。 “我支持詹森。
不是因为我相信任何人都是绝对正确的，而是因为我拒绝相信维护公平就一定意味着与一个对我们来说意义重大的人保持距离。”他们还补充道，“如果美国辜负了帮助建设其未来的人，那么这个世界就不值得黄仁勋。”报道称，内部要求黄仁勋复职的呼声已在英伟达内部论坛上吸引了超过 1,600 条评论，“大多数人完全支持重新任命他”。该公司在全球拥有超过 42,000 名员工。有关 Megaspeed 高管 Alice Huang（涉嫌中国间谍）与黄仁勋关系密切的传闻于 10 月底首次流传，Nvidia 强烈否认有任何不当行为。 “Megaspeed 与许多其他区域云客户没有什么不同。詹森与黄女士的互动并不罕见或出人意料。与客户会面是首席执行官工作的一部分； Nvidia 发言人告诉 Tom's Hardware ：“Jensen 每年都会与数千名客户高管进行交谈。”然而，当有报道称他实际上与黄女士有染时，这位 Nvidia 首席执行官的情况变得更糟。此事传出后，Nvidia 总法律顾问兼董事会秘书 Tim Teter 在 Jensen 家中与 Jensen 进行了对峙，随后他承认了这一点。这位创始人很快发布了一份声明，承认自己的行为并为此道歉，同时公司董事会成立了一个独立委员会调查。
然而，另一起丑闻爆发，这位英伟达前首席执行官又与一名下属发生了外遇。这显然是压垮董事会的最后一根稻草，英伟达联合创始人不久后被迫辞职。报道称，黄仁勋是一位亲力亲为的领导者，公司有 60 多名高管直接向他汇报，而且众所周知，无论白天还是晚上，他都能快速回复电子邮件。但更重要的是，他是公司的代言人，特别受到很多人的喜爱，因此在他的祖国台湾产生了“Jensanity”一词。尽管他是亿万富翁，人们仍然发现他尝试街头小吃，在快餐连锁店吃饭，甚至纪念他在丹尼餐厅做服务员的卑微出身。除了这些最新的丑闻之外，许多游戏玩家还批评黄放弃了英伟达成为人工智能巨头之前支撑英伟达的核心市场。

【原文 English Original】
Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has reportedly called himself “a piece of sh**" as he left the company he built over 33 years. Bloomberg reports that the co-founder, known for his legendary energy and outgoing demeanor, surrendered and looked “broken and shattered” during the board meeting where he resigned from the AI hardware firm after admitting to at least one extra-marital affair , including one with a suspected Chinese spy . But despite his resignation and the controversies surrounding him, it seems that Nvidia employees are still rallying behind him, with thousands of comments on the company’s internal “suggestion box” showing support for the disgraced leader, according to Wired . “If you believe in the mission, bring back THE boss,” one commenter said, while another one wrote, “We are all humans and can make mistakes. Jensen did so many good things and he needs a second chance.” An Nvidia staffer told Wired privately, “Nvidia is Nvidia because of Jensen,” even as another employee sent a company-wide email demanding transparency into his resignation. “I stand by Jensen. Not because I believe any person is infallible, but because I refuse to believe that standing for fairness must mean standing at a distance from someone whose leadership has meant so much to us.” They also added, “If America fails the man who helped build its future, then this world does not deserve Jensen Huang.” According to the report, internal calls for Huang's reinstatement have drawn more than 1,600 comments on Nvidia's internal forums, "the majority in full support of reinstalling him." The company has more than 42,000 employees worldwide. Rumors about Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, an alleged Chinese spy, being close to Jensen Huang first circulated in late October, with Nvidia vehemently denying there was any impropriety. “Megaspeed has been no different than many other regional cloud customers. Jensen’s interactions with Ms. Huang are not unusual or unexpected. Meetings with customers are part of a CEO's job; Jensen talks with thousands of customer executives every year,” an Nvidia spokesperson told Tom's Hardware . However, things took a turn for the worse for the Nvidia CEO when reports came out that he actually had an affair with Ms. Huang . Nvidia General Counsel and Secretary of the Board Tim Teter confronted Jensen at his house when this came out, after which he confessed. The founder soon released a statement admitting to and apologizing for his actions , while the company’s board formed an independent committee to investigate. However, another scandal broke out revealing that the former Nvidia chief had another affair — this time with a subordinate. This was apparently the last straw for the board, and the Nvidia co-founder was forced to resign soon after . Reports say that Jensen Huang was a hands-on leader, with over 60 executives at the company reporting directly to him, and that he was known to respond to emails quickly, whether it was day or night. But, more importantly, he was the face of the company who was particularly loved by many people, giving rise to the term “Jensanity” in his home country of Taiwan . Regardless of his status as a billionaire, people still find him trying out street food , eating at fast food chains , and even honoring his humble beginnings as a busboy at Denny’s . Aside from these latest scandals, many gamers castigate Huang for abandoning the core market that supported Nvidia before it became an AI giant, with consumer graphics cards now drastically more expensive than ever before. He was also often criticized for his all-out push on artificial intelligence and stance on selling chips to China . Still, those issues did not detract from his aura, with his trademark leather jacket raising nearly $1 million at a charity auction. It remains to be seen what will happen to Jensen after his monumental fall from grace, with SpaceX and Tesla mogul Elon Musk noting it would be an honor to hire Huang.

title: Nemaska pause clouds Rio Tinto’s Quebec lithium plans
zh_title: 内马斯卡暂停令力拓魁北克锂计划蒙上阴影
summary: 据《蒙特利尔日报》报道，力拓（LSE、ASX、NYSE：RIO）位于魁北克的 Nemaska 锂工厂的建设计划将在 2027 年之前暂停，这使其计划于 2028 年开工受到质疑。该报援引公司信函报道称，员工周三被告知，工作可能会在 2028 年恢复，尽管这一消息尚未得到证实。魁北克省经济发展部长办公室在早些时候的报告中确认，截至 12 月的裁员人数为 68 人。 “这一决定并不反映力拓或内马斯卡锂业董事会承诺的任何减少，”力拓在放慢速度时表示。
content:
据《蒙特利尔日报》报道，力拓（LSE、ASX、NYSE：RIO）位于魁北克的 Nemaska 锂工厂的建设计划将在 2027 年之前暂停，这使其计划于 2028 年开工受到质疑。该报援引公司信函报道称，员工周三被告知，工作可能会在 2028 年恢复，尽管这一消息尚未得到证实。魁北克省经济发展部长办公室在早些时候的报告中确认，截至 12 月的裁员人数为 68 人。 “这一决定并不反映力拓或 Nemaska Lithium 董事会承诺的任何减少，”力拓在 3 月份放慢建设速度时表示。据该报报道，较长的停顿引发了人们对魁北克省投入该项目的 12 亿加元（合 8.46 亿美元）公共资金回报率的质疑。 3月份该工厂已完成70%以上，当时力拓表示预计总体时间表不会发生重大变化。资金压力贝坎库尔项目是魁北克尝试建立电池供应链的一部分，该供应链将当地开采的矿物转化为更高价值的材料。贝坎库尔位于蒙特利尔东北约 150 公里处，与三河市隔圣劳伦斯河相望。力拓在 2 月份将其持股比例增至 54% 后取得了直接管理控制权。魁北克省通过魁北克投资局持有剩余 46% 的股份。当时，魁北克承诺追加高达2亿美元的股权，力拓承诺在2026年为其魁北克锂业务提供超过3亿美元的资金。
该省将其贡献描述为最终投资，并表示力拓已承诺在 2028 年将该工厂投入使用。最新报道的暂停将使之前预定的首次生产年份的建设重启变得不确定。锂暴跌 BMO 周四援引 Fastmarkets 的消息称，亚洲碳酸锂现货价格已从 5 月份的每公斤 25 美元以上跌至每公斤 12.90 美元。 BMO表示，需求增长疲软以及非洲和中国供应不断扩大给市场带来压力。力拓还在审查该工厂锂辉石的长期供应，锂辉石是一种用于制造氢氧化锂的含锂矿物。该公司一直在评估 Nemaska 的 Whabouchi 项目及其全资拥有的 Galaxy 项目，以确定最佳来源。 2月份，力拓预计供应审查将在今年上半年完成。 BMO周四表示，这两个项目之间的选择仍未解决。周四上午，力拓股价在纽约证券交易所交易中下跌 1.51%，至 83.72 美元，该公司估值约为 1,360 亿美元。去年该股的价格区间为 68.70 美元至 112.58 美元。

【原文 English Original】
Construction of Rio Tinto ’s (LSE, ASX, NYSE: RIO) Nemaska lithium plant in Quebec is set to remain on hold through 2027, putting its planned 2028 start in doubt, according to Le Journal de Montréal. Employees were told Wednesday that work could resume in 2028, although that was unconfirmed, the newspaper reported , citing a company letter. Quebec’s economic development minister’s office had confirmed 68 layoffs extending through December in earlier reporting. “This decision does not reflect any reduction in commitment from Rio Tinto or from the Board of Nemaska Lithium,” Rio said when it slowed construction in March. The longer pause raises questions about the return on C$1.2 billion ($846 million) of public funding that Quebec has put into the venture, according to the newspaper. The plant was more than 70% complete in March, when Rio said it did not foresee major changes to the overall timetable. Funding pressure The Bécancour project forms part of Quebec’s attempt to build a battery supply chain that converts locally mined minerals into higher-value materials. Bécancour lies about 150 km northeast of Montreal, across the St. Lawrence River from Trois-Rivières. Rio took direct management control in February after increasing its interest to 54%. Quebec holds the remaining 46% through Investissement Québec. At the time, Quebec committed up to $200 million in additional equity and Rio pledged more than $300 million for its Quebec lithium business during 2026. The province described its contribution as its final investment and said Rio had committed to bringing the plant into service in 2028. The latest reported pause would leave the construction restart uncertain in the very year previously targeted for first production. Lithium slump Lithium carbonate spot prices in Asia have fallen to $12.90 per kilogram from more than $25 in May, BMO said Thursday, citing Fastmarkets. Weak demand growth and expanding supply from Africa and China have weighed on the market, BMO said. Rio is also reviewing the plant’s long-term supply of spodumene, the lithium-bearing mineral used to make lithium hydroxide. The company has been assessing Nemaska’s Whabouchi project and its wholly owned Galaxy project to determine the best source. In February, Rio expected that supply review to be finished in the first half of the year. BMO said Thursday that the choice between the two projects remained unresolved. Rio shares dropped 1.51% Thursday morning to $83.72 in NYSE trading, valuing the company at about $136 billion. The stock has ranged between $68.70 and $112.58 in the past year.

title: Presidential Message on the Birthday of the United States Marine Corps
zh_title: 美国海军陆战队生日总统致辞
summary: 总统关于美国海军陆战队生日的致辞 搜索 选择类别 所有新闻简报和声明 所有总统行动 行政命令 提名和任命 总统备忘录公告情况说明书 发布评论 研究 所有简报和声明 总统行动 所有行政命令 提名和任命 总统备忘录公告情况说明书 发布评论 研究 两个半世纪以来，美国海军陆战队一直是美国精神的生动体现。带着荣誉、勇气和坚定不移
content:
总统关于美国海军陆战队生日的致辞 搜索 选择类别 所有新闻简报和声明 所有总统行动 行政命令 提名和任命 总统备忘录公告情况说明书 发布评论 研究 所有简报和声明 总统行动 所有行政命令 提名和任命 总统备忘录公告情况说明书 发布评论 研究 两个半世纪以来，美国海军陆战队一直是美国精神的生动体现。凭借荣誉、勇气和对维护和推进美国利益的坚定承诺，海军陆战队一再证明，无论困难如何，他们都会响应每一个召唤并完成任何任务。在海军陆战队庆祝保护美国并击败敌人 251 周年之际，我向每一位为我们的国家战斗和牺牲的海军陆战队员致以最深切的谢意，并向他们无与伦比的英勇遗产致敬。从我们共和国诞生之日起，海军陆战队就一直捍卫美国赖以建立的自由和自由的支柱。独立战争期间，海军陆战队出海夺取拿骚港，为大陆军提供大量军需物资增援。在整个第二次世界大战期间，海军陆战队在整个太平洋战区发挥了关键作用，对于美国在关岛、瓜达尔卡纳尔岛、冲绳岛和硫磺岛的胜利至关重要。
这些令人难以置信的“魔鬼犬”在美国历史上无数次冲突的前线服役，从未失败过保护我们国内外的公民，并在我们的对手面前无所畏惧地展示了美国的威力和力量。今天，通过我们勇敢的海军陆战队的英勇无私的服务，美国变得更加安全。美国海军陆战队的爱国男女不断提醒人们美国伟大和荣耀的真正源泉。作为总统，我是我国历史上最强有力的海军陆战队倡导者。通过超级情报的进步以及对导弹防御、下一代能力和造船的投资，我们正在为我们的海军陆战队提供击败美国敌人所需的一切资源，无论他们身在何处。在我的领导下，我们的海军陆战队员也回到家乡，得到他们应得的关怀和支持。我的政府恢复了退伍军人事务部的常识，使退伍军人能够寻求自己选择的医疗保健提供者，降低退伍军人及其家人的费用，并减少有害的积压。作为总司令，我将永远不会停止为我们的海军陆战队挺身而出，维护他们作为世界上最致命的战斗力量的声誉。在座右铭“Semper Fidelis”（意为“永远忠诚”）的指引下，美国海军陆战队在我们国家和全人类的历史上留下了自己的印记。
我们海军陆战队的坚定力量证明了美国精神的力量和美国武装部队的力量。一代又一代，海军陆战队忠实地充当了美国的捍卫者，他们将在未来的几个世纪里继续作为自由的忠实捍卫者。永远Fi！关于美国海军陆战队生日的总统致辞首先出现在白宫。

【原文 English Original】
Presidential Message on the Birthday of the United States Marine Corps Search Select Category All News Briefings & Statements All Presidential Actions Executive Orders Nominations & Appointments Presidential Memoranda Proclamations Fact Sheets Releases Remarks Research All Briefings & Statements Presidential Actions All Executive Orders Nominations & Appointments Presidential Memoranda Proclamations Fact Sheets Releases Remarks Research For over two and a half centuries, the United States Marine Corps has stood as a living embodiment of the American Spirit.  With honor, courage, and unwavering commitment to preserving and advancing the interests of the United States, Marines have proven time and again that they will answer every call and complete any mission no matter the odds.  As the Marine Corps celebrates 251 years of protecting America and defeating her enemies, I extend my deepest gratitude to every Marine who has fought and sacrificed for our Nation and pay tribute to their unmatched legacy of valor. From the dawn of our Republic, Marines have defended the pillars of freedom and liberty that America was founded upon.  During the Revolutionary War, Marines took to the sea to seize the port of Nassau and reinforce the Continental Army with large quantities of military supplies.  Throughout World War II, Marines played a critical role across the Pacific Theater and were essential to American victories at Guam, Guadalcanal, Okinawa, and Iwo Jima.  These incredible Devil Dogs have served on the front lines of countless conflicts throughout American history, never failed to protect our citizens at home and abroad, and fearlessly demonstrated American might and power in the face of our adversaries.  Today, America is made safer through the heroic and selfless service of our brave Marines. The patriotic men and women of the United States Marine Corps are enduring reminders of the true source of American greatness and glory.  As President, I have been the strongest advocate for our Marines in the history of our country.  Through advancements in Super Intelligence and investments in missile defense, next-generation capabilities, and shipbuilding, we are providing our Marines with every resource they need to defeat America’s enemies wherever they may be. Under my leadership, our Marines also return home to the care and support they have so rightly earned.  My Administration has restored common sense at the Department of Veterans Affairs, empowering veterans to seek the healthcare providers of their choice, lowering costs for veterans and their families, and slashing harmful backlogs.  As Commander in Chief, I will never stop standing up for our Marines and upholding their reputation as the most lethal fighting force the world has ever seen. Guided by their motto, Semper Fidelis, meaning “Always Faithful,” the United States Marines have left their mark on the history of our Nation and all of mankind.  The steadfast strength of our Marines is a testament to the power of the American Spirit and the might of the United States Armed Forces.  Generation after generation, Marines have faithfully served as champions of America, and they will carry on as faithful defenders of liberty for centuries to come.  Semper Fi! title: Topco Scientific Establishes Dresden Hub, Makes SEMICON Europa Debut
zh_title: Topco Scientific 建立德累斯顿中心，SEMICON Europa 首次亮相
summary: 在《欧洲芯片法案》和半导体本土化制造趋势的推动下，欧洲对材料、设备和技术服务的需求日益受到关注。半导体产业综合服务商拓普科科技股份有限公司（TAIEX：5434）宣布，其德国子公司拓普科德国有限公司（TOPCO GERMANY）将首次参加11月10日至13日在德国慕尼黑展览中心举行的SEMICON Europa 2026，与台湾、日本的供应商合作伙伴一起展示其跨界合作。
content:
在《欧洲芯片法案》和半导体本土化制造趋势的推动下，欧洲对材料、设备和技术服务的需求日益受到关注。半导体产业综合服务商拓普科科技股份有限公司（TAIEX：5434）宣布，其德国子公司拓普科德国有限公司（TOPCO GERMANY）将首次参加11月10日至13日在德国慕尼黑展览中心举行的SEMICON Europa 2026，与台湾、日本供应商合作伙伴展示其跨境资源一体化和本地化服务能力。拓普科德国于2026年8月正式成立，将亮相台湾馆，展示涵盖工艺材料、特种化学品、扩散工艺清洗设备、关键零部件的一站式解决方案。这些解决方案旨在支持欧洲代工厂和汽车电子制造商的晶圆厂建设和生产需求。作为欧洲最大的半导体集群之一，德累斯顿是博世、英飞凌、恩智浦和格罗方德等主要半导体公司的所在地。随着世界领先的铸造厂在德国落户，TOPCO SCIENTIFIC 正在加速向欧洲市场的扩张。
该公司利用德累斯顿当地团队提供及时的材料供应和技术支持，将来自台湾、日本和其他市场的领先材料、设备和耗材供应商与欧洲客户联系起来。这种集成服务模式可帮助客户在半导体工厂不断扩张的情况下减轻供应链中断风险，并降低资质和入厂成本。对于关键的前端工艺材料，拓普科将在展会上展示日本供应商SHIN-ETSU POLYMER的12英寸晶圆载具解决方案，满足欧洲12英寸代工厂和集成器件制造商（IDM）严格的清洁度和自动化要求。其前开式统一盒 (FOUP) 具有抗静电保护和一体式结构，有助于缩短清洁和干燥周期，同时有效减少颗粒的产生。该公司还将展示符合 SEMI 标准的前开式运输箱 (FOSB)，并具有坚固的密封结构，可在长途国际运输过程中保护晶圆。为了满足先进半导体工艺的微缩要求，拓普科引进日本先进的前驱体材料，为高端薄膜沉积工艺提供全面的解决方案，包括化学气相沉积（CVD）和物理气相沉积（PVD）。
这些材料具有超高纯度和出色的热稳定性，有助于提高器件性能和产量，支持可靠的先进半导体制造。对于蚀刻和薄膜沉积工艺，TOPCO SCIENTIFIC 将展示使用 TAIWAN E&M SYSTEMS 的定制精密加工能力制造的关键组件。这些组件由石英、硅、陶瓷和碳化硅 (SiC) 制成，与主要半导体设备平台兼容。结合专门的抗等离子和耐磨涂层技术，它们有助于延长设备耗材的使用寿命，使客户能够提高产量，同时支持更可持续的制造。

【原文 English Original】
Driven by the European Chips Act and the trend toward localized semiconductor manufacturing, demand for materials, equipment, and technical services in Europe has attracted growing attention. TOPCO SCIENTIFIC Co., Ltd. (TAIEX: 5434), an integrated services provider for the semiconductor industry, announced that its German subsidiary, TOPCO SCIENTIFIC Germany GmbH (TOPCO GERMANY), will participate for the first time in SEMICON Europa 2026, to be held at Messe München in Germany from November 10 to 13. Together with supplier partners from Taiwan and Japan, the company will showcase its cross-border resource integration and localized service capabilities. Officially established in August 2026, TOPCO GERMANY will exhibit at the Taiwan Pavilion, presenting one-stop solutions covering process materials, specialty chemicals, diffusion process cleaning equipment, and critical components. These solutions are designed to support the fab construction and production needs of European foundries and automotive electronics manufacturers. As one of Europe’s largest semiconductor clusters, Dresden is home to major semiconductor companies, including Bosch, Infineon, NXP, and GlobalFoundries. With the world’s leading foundry establishing a presence in Germany, TOPCO SCIENTIFIC is accelerating its expansion into the European market. Leveraging its local team in Dresden to provide timely materials supply and technical support, the company connects leading materials, equipment, and consumables suppliers from Taiwan, Japan, and other markets with European customers. This integrated service model helps customers mitigate supply chain disruption risks and reduce qualification and onboarding costs amid the ongoing expansion of semiconductor fabs. For critical front-end process materials, TOPCO SCIENTIFIC will showcase 12-inch wafer carrier solutions from Japanese supplier SHIN-ETSU POLYMER at the exhibition, addressing the stringent cleanliness and automation requirements of European 12-inch foundries and integrated device manufacturers (IDMs). Its Front Opening Unified Pod (FOUP), featuring antistatic protection and an integrated, one-piece construction, helps shorten cleaning and drying cycles while effectively minimizing particle generation. The company will also showcase Front Opening Shipping Box (FOSB) that comply with SEMI standards and feature robust sealing structures to protect wafers during long-distance international transportation. To address the scaling requirements of advanced semiconductor processes, TOPCO SCIENTIFIC introduces advanced precursor materials from Japan, offering comprehensive solutions for high-end thin-film deposition processes, including chemical vapor deposition (CVD) and physical vapor deposition (PVD). Featuring ultra-high purity and excellent thermal stability, these materials help enhance device performance and yield, supporting reliable advanced semiconductor manufacturing. For etching and thin-film deposition processes, TOPCO SCIENTIFIC will showcase critical components manufactured using customized precision machining capabilities from TAIWAN E&M SYSTEMS . These components, made from quartz, silicon, ceramics, and silicon carbide (SiC), are compatible with major semiconductor equipment platforms. Combined with specialized plasma-resistant and wear-resistant coating technologies, they help extend the service life of equipment consumables, enabling customers to improve yield while supporting more sustainable manufacturing. For semiconductor facility engineering and equipment maintenance, TOPCO SCIENTIFIC also offers solutions for the maintenance and servicing of critical equipment and precision components. In the diffusion process segment, the company introduces quartz cleaning equipment from Japanese supplier FIRST EXA to improve the cleanliness of quartz components. Using automated acid cleaning and nitrogen purging technologies, the equipment effectively removes residues from high-temperature deposition processes, reduces particle contamination, and extends the service life of quartz consumables, helping safeguard wafer yield. Charles Lee, President of TOPCO SCIENTIFIC, said, “The regionalization and localization of global semiconductor supply chains have become an irreversible trend. TOPCO SCIENTIFIC established its German subsidiary in August 2026, positioning Dresden as its European operational and technical service hub. This move not only strengthens our presence in Europe but also establishes an important strategic hub for global supply chain integration. Building on more than 35 years of experience in the semiconductor industry, we connect suppliers from Taiwan and Japan with local European customers, providing timely technical support and integrated services. Going forward, we will further strengthen strategic cooperation with leading European suppliers to build an international supply chain platform connecting Asia and Europe and serving customers worldwide, thereby enhancing global supply chain resilience.” The post Topco Scientific Establishes Dresden Hub, Makes SEMICON Europa Debut appeared first on Semiconductor Digest .
